title: Manager, Licensing & Partnerships
description: [ WHO WE ARE ] Based out of South Korea, KRAFTON, Inc. is committed to discovering and globally publishing games that deliver a uniquely fun experience with global production studios known for distinctive creatives. Founded in 2007, KRAFTON consists of PUBG STUDIOS, Bluehole Studio, RisingWings, Striking Distance Studios, Dreamotion, Unknown Worlds, 5minlab, Neon Giant, KRAFTON Montréal Studio and ReLU Games, each trying to innovate the enjoyment of games through continuously embracing challenges and new technologies, expanding our platforms and services to win the hearts of more fans. KRAFTON India has established itself as a trailblazer in the gaming industry, driven by its unwavering commitment to delivering distinctive and enjoyable gaming experiences. At the heart of KRAFTON India's success lies a deep understanding of the Indian gaming community. The company takes immense pride in its premier entertainment properties, which include highly popular titles like BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (BGMI), CookieRun India, Road To Valor: Empires, Defense Derby, and New State Mobile. These games have not only captured the hearts of Indian players but have also played a pivotal role in fostering a thriving e-sports ecosystem in the country. With a focus on India, KRAFTON is dedicated to nurturing the gaming and start-up ecosystem. In line with this commitment, KRAFTON initiated the KRAFTON India Gaming Incubator (KIGI) in October 2023. KIGI aims to support 6-10 teams annually, with program durations ranging from six months to one year. Additionally, KRAFTON India has invested over $150 million in the Indian market in the past two years. It has committed an additional $150 million to the Indian start-up ecosystem over the next three years. Nautilus Mobile is an Indian game development studio based in Pune, known for building Real Cricket — India’s most popular mobile cricket gaming franchise. Founded in 2013, the studio has consistently delivered authentic, high-quality cricket simulation experiences to millions of players across India and beyond. Its successful titles include Real Cricket 24, Real Cricket 22, Real Cricket GO, and the legacy favourite Real Cricket Premier League. In April 2025, KRAFTON acquired a majority stake in Nautilus Mobile. This investment reflects its commitment to unlocking opportunities for Indian game developers and supporting the growth of India’s gaming ecosystem. Through this partnership, Nautilus Mobile continues to innovate at the intersection of sport and gaming, shaping the future of interactive cricket entertainment. [ ABOUT THE ROLE ] We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated professional to lead our licensing and partnership efforts related to the cricket ecosystem in India, with potential to expand into broader regional and global cricket gaming rights. This individual will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and securing licensing opportunities ranging from smaller, tactical agreements to complex multi-party, multi-regional deals. The pivotal to building a differentiated and authentic cricket gaming experience. [ RESPONSIBILITIES ] Own end-to-end responsibility for licensing and partnership activities related to cricket teams, leagues, players, stadiums, and associated IPs. Identify, assess, and negotiate licensing opportunities in alignment with the company’s business and product goals. Drive and close deals with a wide range of stakeholders including cricket boards, clubs, players’ associations, sports agencies, and rights holders. Build and nurture long-term strategic relationships across the cricketing ecosystem in India and beyond. Provide strategic insights on cricket licensing trends, competitive landscape, and market dynamics. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, legal, marketing, and publishing teams to align on deal terms and execution plans. Maintain an up-to-date repository of licensing agreements, rights coverage, and performance metrics. [ REQUIREMENTS ] Minimum 10 years of experience in licensing, partnerships, or rights management within the gaming, sports, or entertainment industry. Demonstrated success in managing end-to-end licensing deals – from identification and evaluation to negotiation and closure. Strong understanding of the cricket landscape in India, including key stakeholders, regulatory bodies, and media rights. Proven track record of developing long-term strategic partnerships in a highly dynamic and competitive environment. Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills. Deep business acumen with the ability to align licensing strategy with company goals. Demonstrated ability and commitment to build and sustain long-term relationships with cricket boards, clubs, sports agencies, and rights holders [ PREFERRED ] Prior experience working directly with cricket boards or associations. Background in video game publishing or mobile game licensing, particularly in the sports or cricket genre. Understanding of IP law and licensing frameworks in gaming and sports media.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description: [ WHO WE ARE ] Based out of South Korea, KRAFTON, Inc. is committed to discovering and globally publishing games that deliver a uniquely fun experience with global production studios known for distinctive creatives. Founded in 2007, KRAFTON consists of PUBG STUDIOS, Bluehole Studio, RisingWings, Striking Distance Studios, Dreamotion, Unknown Worlds, 5minlab, Neon Giant, KRAFTON Montréal Studio and ReLU Games, each trying to innovate the enjoyment of games through continuously embracing challenges and new technologies, expanding our platforms and services to win the hearts of more fans. KRAFTON India has established itself as a trailblazer in the gaming industry, driven by its unwavering commitment to delivering distinctive and enjoyable gaming experiences. At the heart of KRAFTON India's success lies a deep understanding of the Indian gaming community. The company takes immense pride in its premier entertainment properties, which include highly popular titles like BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (BGMI), CookieRun India, Road To Valor: Empires, Defense Derby, and New State Mobile. These games have not only captured the hearts of Indian players but have also played a pivotal role in fostering a thriving e-sports ecosystem in the country. With a focus on India, KRAFTON is dedicated to nurturing the gaming and start-up ecosystem. In line with this commitment, KRAFTON initiated the KRAFTON India Gaming Incubator (KIGI) in October 2023. KIGI aims to support 6-10 teams annually, with program durations ranging from six months to one year. Additionally, KRAFTON India has invested over $150 million in the Indian market in the past two years. It has committed an additional $150 million to the Indian start-up ecosystem over the next three years. [ ABOUT THE ROLE ] As a Senior Legal Counsel at Krafton, you will play a pivotal role in providing strategic legal guidance and ensuring compliance across our various and expanding business functions. You will be responsible for handling corporate legal matters, regulatory compliance, intellectual property, commercial contracts, and dispute resolution. This role requires a deep understanding of entertainment and media, technology, and corporate laws, along with strong analytical and communication skills to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders. This is a great opportunity to join a collaborative team, think independently, take initiative of legal affairs, and work in one of the most exciting industries in the world. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be part of a fast-growing legal department and will report directly to the Head of the Legal East Team. [ REQUIREMENTS ] Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LL.B.) from a recognized university in India and licensed to practice law in India. Ideally 7–10 years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful experience at a leading law firm or as in-house counsel in a multinational corporation, preferably in media/entertainment/fintech or any other technology industry. Strong, well-rounded commercial contracting experience, particularly in technology, licensing, intellectual property, marketing and partnership arrangements, and a grounding in corporate law. Strong understanding and experience in highly regulated areas such as payments, e-commerce, data protection, content regulation, and telecommunications, and an understanding of the general legal and regulatory landscape for digital businesses in India. Able to work independently and handle day-to-day legal tasks. Flexibility to work with different time zones. Team player capable of working both independently and with others. Strong sense of customer support and excellent interpersonal/communication skills with the ability to distil complex legal analysis into clear, concise advice for non-lawyers. Strategic mindset with the ability to manage complex legal issues and support multiple businesses with shifting priorities. Must have a sense of humor! A general interest in gaming is a plus. [ RESPONSIBILITIES ] Draft, review, and negotiate complex commercial contracts across the group, including service and vendor agreements, technology, platform and SaaS agreements, licensing agreements, content acquisition agreements, marketing and brand partnership agreements, publishing and development agreements, strategic collaborations, and data- privacy-related agreements. Track, research and advise on developments in Indian law affecting our businesses, including in online gaming, financial services/fintech, information technology and intermediary obligations, consumer protection, advertising, and translate them into clear, actionable guidance. Support the management of civil and criminal litigation and disputes. Respond to requests from law enforcement and investigative authorities. Oversee internal investigations and ensure policy alignment across the KRAFTON group. Support compliance functions, including employment, and protect and leverage the group's intellectual property, working closely with our global legal colleagues. Collaborate with HQ on global legal strategy and cross-border regulatory issues. Provide practical legal counsel across all levels of the organization and support global legal department operations, including translating legal concepts for business stakeholders and working closely with production, marketing, and business development teams. Actively engage in hands-on legal work where necessary to support business needs and ensure alignment with organizational goals. Build templates, playbooks and processes that help the legal team scale and make legal support faster and more consistent. Perform other relevant legal duties as assigned.

title: Associate Manager, Partnerships
description: Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution. Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia. Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia. But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future. About the Role : Razorpay’s partnership team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Channel partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you will be on the front line of interacting with our key Technology partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Razorpay's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help grow the enterprise business. As an Associate Manager for Partnership, you will foster and manage relationships with some of the biggest tech companies in India. You will own C-level relationships with key partners and grow them to their potential. You will work on cutting edge payments products that deliver processing solutions for our merchants. You will also create large, consistent business growth streams for Razorpay by unlocking great value for merchants. As an Associate Manager for Partnership, you will foster and manage relationships with some of the biggest tech companies in India. You will own C-level relationships with key partners and grow them to their potential. You will work on cutting edge payments products that deliver processing solutions for our merchants. You will also create large, consistent business growth streams for Razorpay by unlocking great value for merchants. Roles and Responsibilities: Account Planning and Execution: Develop account plans for assigned partner portfolio, outlining objectives, strategies, and tactics to drive retention and growth. Execute account plans effectively, ensuring alignment with partner goals and company objectives Retention Strategy Development: Develop and execute strategies to retain and grow the assigned portfolio. This involves analyzing partner needs, identifying retention risks, and implementing targeted initiatives to mitigate churn Partner training and education Partner Performance Monitoring and Reporting Develop an in-depth knowledge of Razorpay core products via successful completion of required sales Training program, and utilize this knowledge to successfully lead the assigned retention/farming portfolio Relationship Management- Representing Razorpay at conferences and networking events Local and Domestic travel might be required on a need basis Work effectively with internal support departments (Sales, Marketing and Product Development) to develop effective sales strategies that promote sales to new and existing customers ● Continuously research and remain knowledgeable of industry trends and competition. Mandatory Qualification: Experience of 2-5 years in sales roles preferably within the payments industry and worked as an individual contributor Proven sales experience in specified territories and verticals Able to drive customer centricity Quick learner, adaptable to changing business needs The role involves domestic traveling and hence candidates need to be prepared for the same Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. title: Architect Manager, Data & AI (GenAI) — Tax Automations & Innovation
jobTitle: Architect Manager, Data & AI (GenAI) — Tax Automations & Innovation
description: About the Team The Tax Technology Automations & Innovation team — known internally as the AI Team — builds the automations, Generative AI, and internal tooling that let DoorDash's global Tax function scale as the business grows across the US, Canada, and — through Wolt and Deliveroo — internationally. We turn manual, repetitive tax work into reliable, governed software, and we bring modern AI into the heart of how a tax function operates — responsibly, and with auditability built in. The team is organised into an AI Strategy function and three regional pillars: EMEA, US & Canada, and Coffee & Special Projects. This role sits in the AI Strategy function and reports to the Tax Technology lead. You will set the technical and AI direction the three regional pillars build around, and partner across Tax, Tax Tech, Data Operations, Accounting, Product, and Engineering, as well as InfoSec, Internal Audit, and Compliance. About the Role DoorDash is looking for a senior-level AI and data expert to lead how the Tax department operates through automation, Generative AI, and intelligent data tooling. Beyond building high-impact automation, you will set the strategy for how LLMs, GenAI, and machine learning are integrated into critical tax workflows at scale, and act as the AI authority for the function. This is the role that makes the entire team AI-native rather than merely AI-assisted. By owning the AI and automation governance framework, you will also ensure that everything the team builds on top of sensitive tax data stays controlled, defensible, and audit-ready. You don't just build — you set the bar, mentor the regional teams, and decide how we adopt a fast-moving technology responsibly. You're excited about this opportunity because you will… Define and lead the GenAI strategy for the Tax function, identifying high-value use cases and setting adoption standards. Architect and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions — intelligent assistants, AI-driven classification, anomaly detection, automated audit support, document summarization, and retrieval-augmented reporting. Own the AI and automation governance framework — model risk, change control, testing and validation standards, documentation, and auditability for tools that touch tax data and filings. Set the rules for responsible, controlled AI use, including data privacy, data residency, and what data may be sent to external model providers, partnering with InfoSec, Internal Audit, and Compliance. Partner with senior Tax, Product, and Engineering leaders to drive requirements and deliver measurable business impact. Mentor the Senior Analysts and Associate Managers across all regional pillars on applying GenAI/LLMs effectively and within governance guardrails. Quantify, track, and communicate the business impact of AI solutions (efficiency gains, error reduction, compliance risk mitigation). We're excited about you because… You have 8+ years of hands-on experience in AI, GenAI, and data automation, delivering production-grade solutions at scale. You have deep expertise in LLMs and GenAI techniques — prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, evaluation frameworks, conversational AI, classification, and summarization. You are advanced in Python and SQL and have built scalable AI and automation pipelines. You have a strong background in automation and applied analytics, ideally in tax, finance, or regulated industries. You have deployed AI in cloud data environments such as Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, or Databricks. You have expertise in AI governance, compliance, and risk management for regulated environments. You can translate complex AI capabilities into intuitive tools for non-technical users, and influence at all levels from hands-on teams to executives. You have a Bachelor's degree or higher. You have (preferably) knowledge of tax technology platforms or experience with global tax teams You have (preferably) experience in a high-growth technology, marketplace, or e-commerce company. About DoorDash At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection. We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in certain locations. The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: https://getcovey.com/nyc-local-law-144 To request a reasonable accommodation under applicable law or alternate selection process, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

You have deep expertise in LLMs and GenAI techniques — prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, evaluation frameworks, conversational AI, classification, and summarization. You are advanced in Python and SQL and have built scalable AI and automation pipelines. You have a strong background in automation and applied analytics, ideally in tax, finance, or regulated industries. You have deployed AI in cloud data environments such as Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, or Databricks. You have expertise in AI governance, compliance, and risk management for regulated environments. You can translate complex AI capabilities into intuitive tools for non-technical users, and influence at all levels from hands-on teams to executives. You have a Bachelor's degree or higher. You have (preferably) knowledge of tax technology platforms or experience with global tax teams You have (preferably) experience in a high-growth technology, marketplace, or e-commerce company. title: Support Analyst II
description: About Vista Equity Partners: Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem. Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams. About Amtech Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise. With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem. Our Employee Value Proposition At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can: Purpose Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations. Growth Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths. Culture Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision. Innovation Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing operational processes across the business. Amtech is seeking a Labels Application Support Associate to support the Label Traxx ERP platform, Batched scheduling solution, and Siteline web-to-print platform used throughout the label and narrow-web converting industry. This is a hands-on technical role focused on troubleshooting, configuration, reporting, integrations, and customer support. It is not a ticket-only support position. It requires technical ownership, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to work across application, database, reporting, and system-level issues. Print industry experience is required. Understanding how label and narrow-web print shops operate and do business matters more than ERP expertise. Technical skills can be built; industry context cannot. Candidates without print industry background will not be considered. Schedule Standard working hours are 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM IST. During the first 90 days, an offset training schedule may require availability up to 11:00 AM Eastern Time on selected days. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES •Own support cases end-to-end across Label Traxx, Batched, and Siteline — from initial diagnosis through resolution •Troubleshoot complex issues spanning application logic, database records, reporting, integrations, and infrastructure •Analyze application data, customer configurations, and workflow issues to validate system behavior and identify root causes •Modify and execute queries to investigate data-related problems and support Batched configuration and rule troubleshooting •Support Batched scheduling, workflow configuration, and customer implementations; troubleshoot scheduling rules, production planning logic, and workflow automation •Support Siteline storefront implementations, including order processing, artwork approval workflows, and Label Traxx-to-Siteline integration issues •Troubleshoot Windows servers, services, and application environments; configure and support Label Traxx as a Windows service •Analyze logs, system behavior, and service failures to identify root causes; support server upgrades, migrations, and environment validation •Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, KB articles, and SOPs; research prior cases and documentation before escalating •Identify recurring issues and recommend durable solutions; contribute to support process improvements •Partner with Product, Development, Professional Services, Infrastructure, and Customer Success teams •Escalate product defects with detailed reproduction steps and supporting evidence •Participate in testing and validation of new features and product releases •Support customers across North America and Europe; participate in off-hours work as needed for upgrades, installations, and critical incidents SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS Required •Print industry experience — label, narrow-web, or converting; this is a firm requirement •Strong working knowledge of how print shops operate, estimate, schedule, and fulfill orders •2–4 years in application support, technical help desk, or customer-facing technical support environments •Strong troubleshooting skills across applications, databases, Windows servers, and basic networking •Experience working with logs, diagnostics, and system analysis tools •Ability to debug application logic, workflows, and reporting solutions •Excellent written and verbal English communication skills •Self-directed, research-driven approach to problem-solving Preferred •Experience with Label Traxx, Batched, Siteline, or comparable ERP/MIS/scheduling platforms •Crystal Reports or similar reporting tool experience •Data warehouse or BI concepts; Power BI experience a plus •Estimating, costing, or production planning background Nice to Have •JavaScript, API, or integration experience WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — FIRST 6 MONTHS •Independently troubleshoot Label Traxx, Batched, and Siteline issues with minimal escalation •Contribute to Super Reports development and maintenance •Support customer implementations, upgrades, and integrations •Build and maintain high-quality knowledge base content •Operate as a trusted technical resource for customers and internal teams WHY JOIN AMTECH At Amtech, you will play a key role in supporting mission-critical systems for customers across the label and packaging industry while working within a global, collaborative support model. Backed by Vista’s ecosystem, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your technical expertise, work alongside experienced teams across regions, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of Amtech’s solutions and customer experience.

title: Fraud Risk Quality Assurance Analyst
description: About Bluevine Bluevine is the largest small business banking platform in the U.S., redefining how entrepreneurs manage their money. We create modern financial solutions, from checking and lending to payments and beyond, designed to help small business owners grow, thrive, and take control of their financial future. Our best-in-class technology, advanced security, and deep understanding of the small business community give our customers the confidence to focus on what they do best. Since 2013, we’ve supported more than 750,000 small businesses nationwide. Backed by leading investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Menlo Ventures, 83North, and Citi Ventures, our 500+ person global team shares one mission: to give small businesses the financial tools they need to succeed. We’re innovators driven by big ideas, collaboration, and real impact. Here, you’ll have the freedom to take ownership, grow your career, and make a difference for small business owners across America. Ready to shape what’s next? This is a hybrid role . At Bluevine, we pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, which we believe is best maintained through in-person interactions and a vibrant office environment. All of our offices have reopened in accordance with local guidelines, and are following a hybrid model. In-office days will be determined by location and discipline. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Fraud Risk Quality Assurance Analyst, you play a critical function in ensuring that our Risk Operations align with business goals. The primary focus is on identifying common fraud and risk issues, improving the customer experience, and ensuring procedure compliance. You will achieve this by meticulously monitoring the effectiveness and quality of alert reviews and cases. This involves identifying areas of improvement across Risk Operations. WHAT YOU'LL DO: QA Evaluations : Conducts team audits/evaluations to ensure processes and procedures are properly followed. Follows strict deadlines for daily, weekly, and monthly audit due dates. Must meet audit quota. Assist operations in tracking, documenting, and reporting quality assurance scores Coaching Sessions : Offer feedback via verbal & written communication by conducting Coaching Sessions with Agents. Lead internal and QA team calibrations to identify opportunities for improvement. Develop and execute executive updates and reporting on QA results Identify and raise potential gaps in our processes, training materials, content and recommend improvements while ensuring a consistent and optimal level of quality for all deliverables. Leverage QA process knowledge to lead in documenting and refining procedures and processes while developing and implementing coaching strategies for continuous improvement. Uphold the integrity and consistency of quality standards. Perform other job related duties as assigned. WHAT WE LOOK FOR: 2+ years of relevant experience in quality assurance, control or monitoring Excellent written and verbal communication skills Flexible, Proactive and able to multitask Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to projects and deadlines US Banking and financial experience Benefits & Perks Excellent group health coverage and life insurance Meal allowance Transportation assistance (terms and conditions apply) Generous paid time off plan, Holidays Company-sponsored mental health benefits Financial advisory services for both short- and long-term goals Learning and development opportunities to support career growth Community-based volunteering opportunities

title: Junior Analyst, Risk Management
description: Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution. Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia. Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia. But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future. Job Title - Analyst - Risk Management The Role: The role will involve establishing and nurturing relationships with channel partners to promote and sell our products or services. You will play a critical role in expanding our business through strategic partnerships and ensuring the successful onboarding of new partners. Job Summary This role requires strong knowledge and experience in Sanctions, AML (Anti-Money Laundering), and Financial Crimes. The position will focus on Customer Due Diligence (CDD), website assessment, risk assessment associated with merchant onboarding, and Transaction Monitoring, covering all aspects of business model validation and compliance. Roles and Responsibilities Conduct onboarding and ongoing customer due diligence. Conduct and perform quality control relative to a variety of investigation types, including suspicious activity, sanctions, and enhanced due diligence (EDD). Manage daily escalation queues, handling complex or exception cases from business and operations teams. Participate in process improvement, identifying and implementing best practices in effective and innovative ways. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) with comprehensive knowledge about AML policies, fraud control, risk categorization policies, monitoring, evaluation, review, and associated reporting. Demonstrate excellent knowledge of reporting procedures and record-keeping guidelines. Maintain the ability to communicate clearly and precisely to the point with stakeholders. ● Should be familiar with essential screening tools, including Dow Jones and LexisNexis. Qualifications Required Experience/Knowledge: ○ Knowledge about a customer support application or CRM, such as Freshdesk. ○ Familiarity with Stages/levels of chargebacks, penalty involved at the arbitration stage, technical chargebacks, Visa/Mastercard guidelines (in brief), and reason codes in relation to fraud chargebacks. Core Skills: ○ Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication. ○ Listening Skills: Ability to understand, anticipate, and resolve queries arising from various stakeholders. ○ Attention to Detail and Accuracy: Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to identify anomalies or suspicious behaviors. ○ Interpersonal Skills: Friendly and pleasant demeanor over the phone and email. ● Education: ○ Bachelor's Degree. Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

About the role We're hiring a Lead Communication Designer for the product marketing design pod in Razorpay's in-house creative studio. The pod designs product marketing content, GTMs, feature launches, and advertising campaigns for every Razorpay product across countries, and takes part in Razorpay brand and ad campaigns. You'll lead a high-talent team of motion designers, art directors, editors, and AI builders — winner of Creative and Design Team at the ET Brand Disruption Awards 2026, with recent wins at Kyoorius, Effie, and the Shorty Awards — and take its work up a notch. You're an art director first, a brand builder through campaigns, and someone who builds with AI, not just uses it. What you'll own Art direction and brand Set creative direction for product marketing content, GTMs, feature launches, and advertising campaigns across countries — shoots, storyboards, motion, edit, type, and colour. Own pod-level charters end to end across products like Payment Gateway, Cross Border, POS, Engage, Cards, and RazorpayX. Take part in Razorpay brand and ad campaigns, and lead flagship moments like FTX and IPL. Shape briefs with PMMs: challenge weak positioning, sharpen the narrative, and pitch campaigns before anyone asks. Turn campaign wins into brand systems — visual languages, imagery styles, motion kits — every product can use. AI at scale Push Midjourney, Nano Banana, Runway, Higgsfield, and Seedance past generic output to brand-quality videos, campaigns, and product identities. Keep the studio fun and social — jams, show-and-tells, celebrating good work loudly — and help hire. Collaboration Has worked closely with PMMs, marketing managers, brand managers, and social media teams, and led junior designers, animators, and editors. Craft Art direction across Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, with basic motion and editing skills — and above all, strong taste. Who you are 6–8 years in communication design, art direction, or brand design, ideally across in-house brand teams and creative or advertising agencies. A portfolio with strong art direction: campaigns and films where you shaped the look, the story, and the tone. Proven record of building or evolving a brand through campaign work, with results you can point to (reach, awards, adoption, business impact). Strong across graphics, motion, video, and landing pages. Ships production work with Midjourney, Nano Banana, Runway, Higgsfield, and Seedance, and has built automations with Claude or Gemini through APIs or MCPs. Has led a team of 3–5 designers, animators, or video editors day to day — sprint sheets, weekly workload, reviews — and can show how they grew under you. Confident with senior stakeholders: you can push back on a weak brief, pitch an idea to leadership, and win the room. Warm, social, and fun to work with — people want to be on your team. title: AI Engineer III – Agentic Platform
description: About Vista Equity Partners Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem. Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams. About Amtech Amtech LLC is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging and manufacturing industries, helping businesses streamline operations, improve productivity, and drive sustainable growth. With a strong focus on innovation and customer success, Amtech continues to expand its global footprint and deliver technology that empowers teams around the world. Our Employee Value Proposition At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can: Purpose Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations. Growth Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths. Culture Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision. Innovation Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business. Role Description Amtech LLC is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to build and scale the Agentic Platform behind Amtech AI Intelligence — a headless, MCP-native intelligence layer across packaging and labels, and data that is callable by any AI, on any screen. This role takes Amtech's first production agent pattern and turns it into a reusable platform component that extends cleanly to EnCore, LabelTraxx, Siteline, Scorekeeper, and future use cases, rather than building a one-off solution per product. This is a senior, largely self-directed role: you'll set technical direction for the platform, make build-vs-buy calls on agent tooling, and be a technical reference point for the Forward Deployed Engineers embedding it into product pods. Curiosity about emerging agentic AI and LLM tooling, and comfort operating close to production systems and governed customer data, are essential. Job Description Headless, MCP-Native Architecture Build business logic that runs independent of any screen — the same capability must work for a person in the UI, an AI agent, or an automated job. Expose Amtech capabilities as MCP-described tools so any AI model can call them. Orchestration and Agent Execution Build and maintain the LLM orchestration layer that turns model output into safe, governed, tool-using actions. Implement and extend agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Retrieval and Model Integration Build and tune RAG pipelines for grounding agent responses in Amtech's own data. Integrate model-agnostic LLM providers — Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and whatever model leads next — via a common provider abstraction, avoiding vendor lock-in. Governed On-Prem Data Access (the Data Agent) Build and maintain the Data Agent — new technology that reads EnCore and other customer data directly for inferencing, with no dependency on legacy point-to-point APIs. Ensure every agent action passes governed approval gates before it executes, with a complete, queryable audit trail — customer data stays in the customer's environment while still enabling cloud-LLM reasoning over it. Building Amtech AI Intelligence Capabilities Extend the platform into concrete delivered capabilities such as Schedule Intelligence (watching schedules, flagging conflicts and trim-loss, proposing re-sequencing), Order & Customer Intelligence (full-context status across specs, history, and dates), Docs & Knowledge (cited, grounded answers with stale-document detection), and Forecast & KPI Intelligence (plain-language questions over throughput, waste, and OTIF). Plugging Into Amtech's Broader Agent Portfolio Amtech already runs 10+ active agents company-wide — this role's platform work is what lets patterns from those efforts be reused instead of rebuilt. Directly support the Utilization mandate to extend engineering's agent-building cadence to Sales, Support, and Customer Success, so new agents in those functions can be built on the same governed orchestration, RAG, and audit foundation rather than one-off tooling. Scaling the Platform Pattern Across Product Lines Turn Amtech's first production agent pattern into a reusable platform component that other product pods can adopt without a rebuild. Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers embedded in product pods to validate the platform against real workflows and feed field learnings back into the roadmap. Deployment, Monitoring, and Cost Control Deploy agents and inference endpoints on AWS (e.g., Lambda, ECS/EKS, SageMaker) and integrate them into existing APIs and microservices. Set up evals, cost controls, and basic observability to catch regressions, drift, or runaway spend before they reach customers. Bridging into ML Engineering and MLOps Bring enough classical ML engineering and MLOps fluency (feature stores, model registries, CI/CD for models, drift monitoring) to partner effectively with the Data Science, ML Engineering, and MLOps functions, not just the agentic/LLM side of the platform. As a senior technical voice on the team, weigh in on production practices — deployment, monitoring, retraining — across both agentic and classical ML workloads as the org scales toward a lead role. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related field. 4-6 years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years hands-on building production systems with large language models. Demonstrated experience setting technical direction and reviewing the work of other engineers, even if not a formal people-management role. Strong Python programming skills. Practical experience with prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph). Experience integrating at least one major LLM provider API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock). title: Analyst, Banking Alliances
description: Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution. Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia. Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia. But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia. title: Manager, Indirect Tax Technology
description: About the Team DoorDash is looking for an experienced Manager, Tax Technology to lead the offshore Vertex & ERP Integrations Center of Excellence (CoE) within our growing Tax Team. The tax engine (Vertex) calculates the correct sales tax and VAT on every order across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo platforms, and this role owns the deep technical expertise that keeps that engine accurate. As DoorDash continues to grow its global footprint across multiple business lines, we are looking for a candidate with hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and maintaining indirect tax engines, with the integration to ERP systems on both AR and AP sides, who can also lead and develop a team of configuration and testing specialists. You will be the central technical authority the rest of the platform team relies on, blending technical indirect tax knowledge, tax-engine experience, and people leadership. About the Role You will report to the Senior Manager of the Tax Calculation Platform & Mx Operations and lead the offshore Center of Excellence — the hub of Vertex configuration, automated testing, and tax-content maintenance. You will set technical standards, oversee the work of Associate Managers, and serve as the senior point of escalation for complex configuration and testing issues. The primary focus of this position is end-to-end tax engine solutions for sales and use taxes, food and beverage taxes and fees, gross receipts taxes, and VAT — ensuring the correct tax is calculated on every product, fee, and country before anything goes live. You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… Own the technical configuration of Vertex — tax drivers, taxability mappings, custom rules, and jurisdiction logic — and lead configuration design for high-complexity initiatives. Lead and develop the offshore CoE team, allocating workload, establishing QA checkpoints, and providing structured knowledge transfer on complex processes. Design, standardize, and enhance the automated tax testing framework across all phases (unit, integration, E2E, shadow, regression and post-launch). Serve as the senior point of escalation for defects found during testing and provide the go-live technical recommendation for production releases. Partner with Vertex to understand updates to product offerings, tax engine technical Q&A, and manage Vertex support tickets. Oversee monthly Vertex content review, quarterly Vertex service releases and validation and maintain the integrity of the fallback system. Own the overall Vertex governance framework and provide cross-functional access and review to other tax teams (e.g. Tax Advisory and Planning Team). Provide technical impact assessments for new business initiatives, new verticals, engine migrations, and integrations. Own the ERP-to-Vertex integration (e.g. Oracle NetSuite), ensuring transactions flow correctly from upstream ERP systems and calculated tax flows into finance systems (NetSuite) and downstream reporting. Partner with cross functional teams and translate business and tax requirements into system logic, and review BRDs, PRDs, and TDDs for tax-system implications. We’re excited about you because… You have 8+ years of experience in a corporate tax department, public accounting, or technology consulting firm, or other related experience, including hands-on indirect tax technology work. Hands-on experience implementing and configuring Vertex O Series (on-premise, on-demand and/or Edge), including tax drivers, taxability mappings, and custom rules. Hands-on experience integrating Vertex O Series with an ERP system (Oracle NetSuite or similar), with the depth to lead ERP-to-Vertex projects directly. Experience with global Vertex implementation across US indirect tax and global VAT regimes Experience with indirect taxes in the US and familiarity with other countries' indirect tax regimes (including VAT). Experience with cross functional collaboration with tax and non-tax teams (including but not limited to tax advisory and planning, engineering, product, tax compliance, business stakeholders) and translate business and tax requirements into Vertex functional requirements and design. Demonstrated people-leadership or team-lead experience, including coaching, workload delegation, and quality oversight. Project management experience, including creation of project plans, milestones, timelines, and tracking of deliverables and risks. Strong system testing experience and the ability to design and govern a structured testing framework. Experience in use of API testing tools like Postman, SOAP UI and ability to read XML and JSON logs Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, or Computer Science degree. You are fluent in leveraging multiple AI tools on the market (e.g., Claude Cowork, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor) on a daily basis across all of your assigned tasks, and you actively look for creative ways to apply them to enhance processes and create efficiency gains. Nice to Haves Experience with Alteryx, Snowflake, SQL and data reconciliation tools. Vertex Certified Implementer certification Marketplace Facilitator laws Vertex Edge About DoorDash At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection. We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in certain locations. The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: https://getcovey.com/nyc-local-law-144 To request a reasonable accommodation under applicable law or alternate selection process, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Role Summary The Territory Sales Manager (TSM) / Senior Territory Sales Manager (Sr. TSM) will be responsible for driving merchant acquisition and revenue growth across the assigned territory. The role involves managing relationships with Retail merchants, Enterprise customers, Aggregators, and Banking partners while ensuring seamless onboarding, deployment, and portfolio management of Razorpay's Offline Payment Solutions. The incumbent will focus on new business acquisition (Hunting) and relationship management & portfolio growth (Farming) , while collaborating closely with internal cross-functional teams to deliver an exceptional merchant experience. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Sales Drive sales of Razorpay Offline Payment Solutions across the assigned territory. Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and deployment targets. Identify and acquire new merchants across Retail, SME, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments. Build a strong pipeline through field sales, referrals, banking channels, and partner networks. Generate consistent business opportunities through market mapping, prospecting, and local market development. Drive revenue growth through effective hunting, farming, cross-sell, and upsell initiatives. Merchant Acquisition & Onboarding Acquire new merchants for Razorpay POS, Soundbox (SB), and Payment Gateway (PG), wherever applicable. Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to onboarding and activation. Ensure timely documentation, KYC completion, installation, and merchant activation. Coordinate internally to ensure smooth merchant onboarding and faster turnaround times. Develop and strengthen the Retail merchant ecosystem within the assigned territory. Banking Channel & Relationship Management Develop and maintain strong working relationships with partner bank branches, sales teams, and key banking stakeholders. Drive quality merchant acquisition and business generation through the bank channel. Generate merchant referrals through banking partnerships. Conduct joint customer meetings and business development initiatives with bank stakeholders. Identify and maximize business opportunities through existing and new banking relationships. Build strong, long-term relationships with banking partners to achieve business targets. Relationship & Portfolio Management Manage the assigned merchant portfolio and ensure high merchant engagement. Build strong long-term relationships with existing merchants and key stakeholders. Drive cross-sell and upsell opportunities across Razorpay's payment solutions. Improve merchant retention and transaction growth within the portfolio. Conduct periodic merchant visits and business reviews. Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion and revenue growth. Team Leadership & Performance Management Lead, manage, and mentor the sales team to achieve business and revenue targets. Drive team productivity through effective planning, performance tracking, coaching, and regular reviews. Set clear goals and ensure timely achievement of individual and team targets. Monitor team performance and provide continuous guidance and support. Build a high-performance, target-driven sales culture across the territory. Aggregator & Enterprise Business Build relationships with aggregators, franchise networks, and enterprise customers. Identify opportunities to onboard key enterprise accounts within the territory. Coordinate with internal enterprise and solution teams to ensure successful implementation. Develop strategic partnerships to expand Razorpay's merchant and enterprise presence. Market Development Develop a strong understanding of the Retail and payments ecosystem within the assigned territory. Track competitor activities, pricing, market trends, and emerging opportunities. Identify new business opportunities and untapped market segments. Execute local sales campaigns and merchant engagement activities. Increase Razorpay's visibility and market share within the assigned territory. Leverage local market knowledge, particularly across Tamil Nadu , to drive business growth. Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Management Work closely with Operations, Product, Risk, Finance, Customer Success, and Installation teams. Manage relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless execution. Ensure timely merchant onboarding, deployment, and issue resolution. Escalate and resolve merchant concerns to maintain a superior customer experience. Provide market feedback to internal teams for continuous product improvement. Desired Candidate Profile 8–10 years of experience in Merchant Acquiring, FinTech, Banking, Payment Solutions, POS Sales, or Financial Services. Strong experience in Bank Channel and Retail business . Preferably strong market exposure and business experience across Tamil Nadu (TN) . Proven experience in managing and developing banking relationships and driving business through the bank channel. Strong understanding of the Retail ecosystem , including customer acquisition, merchant/business development, and revenue generation. Proven experience in field sales, merchant acquisition, and portfolio management . Demonstrated experience in leading and managing sales teams , driving productivity, and achieving business targets. Strong exposure to Retail, SME, Enterprise, Aggregator, and Banking channels. Good understanding of POS acquiring, Soundbox, QR, and Payment Gateway solutions. Excellent stakeholder management, relationship-building, negotiation, communication, and execution skills. Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently in a target-driven environment. Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory. Preferred Industry Experience Merchant Acquiring FinTech Banking Digital Payments POS Sales Payment Gateway Retail Sales Enterprise Sales Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Merchant Acquisitions POS Deployments Soundbox Deployments Banking-Sourced Business Enterprise & Aggregator Acquisitions Active Merchant Base Portfolio Growth Merchant Retention Cross-sell & Upsell Revenue Sales Target Achievement Team Productivity & Target Achievement Customer Satisfaction & Service Levels Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. Software Engineer (Senior) – Platform Engineering & AI-Powered Process Automation Location: Chennai, India | Work Model: On-site Architect the foundational systems powering the next generation of global software execution. About the Team The Platform Engineering, Foundations & Enablement team builds the bedrock of Appian’s technical ecosystem. By delivering resilient shared services, automated developer tooling, and core frameworks, this team enables engineering organizations to build scalable enterprise solutions and accelerates Appian’s growth in the AI-Powered Process Automation market. The Opportunity Top-tier engineers join Appian to tackle deep distributed systems challenges at massive enterprise scale. This role gives you direct ownership over the core platform architecture and internal developer tools that power critical workflows worldwide. If you want to eliminate engineering friction, set architecture standards, and shape high-concurrency systems using cutting-edge enterprise tech, this opportunity offers high visibility and immediate technical influence. Execute technical spikes to clear architectural runways, ensuring system stability, modularity, and seamless long-term scalability. Elevate engineering standards by leading rigorous code reviews, driving proactive refactoring, and optimizing low-latency performance. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers, fostering engineering excellence and operational accountability. Eliminate developer friction by designing automated workflows and self-service platform tools that maximize developer velocity. Author comprehensive design documents and system guides to maintain strong architectural alignment across multi-functional engineering teams. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 5+ years of software engineering experience focusing on Platform Engineering , Enterprise Software Design , or Developer Enablement . Deep hands-on proficiency in core backend languages including Java , Python , or Go . Demonstrated background in Distributed Systems , Microservices , modular design, and high-throughput API Development . Robust troubleshooting and observability skills utilizing industry-standard Telemetry , Logging , and Monitoring tools. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform , CloudFormation , or AWS CDK , along with modern CI/CD pipelines. Expertise with AWS Cloud Services (Compute, Storage, Networking, Security), alongside Docker , Kubernetes , or EKS . Exposure to GitOps workflows, Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) , or Cloud Cost Optimization strategies. Knowledge of enterprise security frameworks, including SOC2 or FedRAMP . We value your experience within enterprise ecosystems like Salesforce or ServiceNow , as these skills translate exceptionally well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities. Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups . These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to. title: Agent Engineer
description: About Prodigal Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations. We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time. These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved? Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them. Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America. Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next. We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect. We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje What You’ll Do Build and deploy LLM-powered AI agents (including voice agents) in production, designed for real-world use cases Own the end-to-end lifecycle of AI systems — from problem scoping and design to deployment, monitoring, and continuous iteration Design and optimize prompts, RAG pipelines, and evaluation frameworks to improve accuracy, latency, and reliability Work directly with customers and Implementation Managers (IMs) to understand workflows, solve real-world problems, and drive successful go-lives and iterations What We’re Looking For 1–3 years experience in backend / data / AI engineering Strong in Python + SQL Experience or exposure to LLMs, RAG, or prompt engineering High ownership, ability to work in ambiguity and ship fast Comfortable working with customers and cross-functional teams Preferred Qualification B.Tech, BE, or M.Tech in Computer Science or a related discipline, with 1–3 years of relevant experience Bonus Experience with production LLM systems / AI agents Familiarity with evaluation, agent tooling, or voice AI Experience with Databricks, MongoDB, or distributed systems Startup or customer-facing engineering experience Why This Role Work on real production AI systems (not demos) End-to-end ownership and fast iteration cycles Direct impact on enterprise customers and business outcomes Mode of Work - In-Office From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast-paced, intellectually-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US. To learn more about us - please visit the following: Our Story - https://www.prodigaltech.com/our-story What shapes our thinking - https://link.prodigaltech.com/our-thesis Our website - https://www.prodigaltech.com/
