title: Group Manager, Banking Solutions
description: Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution. Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia. Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia. But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future. About Razorpay Razorpay is a leading full-stack financial services organization building a new-age digital banking hub (Neobank) for businesses. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar, Razorpay processes multi-billion-dollar payment volumes annually across India and international markets, touching over 200 million end-customers through industry leaders such as Airtel, Goibibo, Yatra, Ola, Swiggy, Zomato, and Cred. The company has raised over $700 million in funding from marquee investors including GIC, Sequoia Capital, Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, and Matrix Partners. Razorpay's suite of digital offerings spans Payment Gateway, RazorpayX (Business Banking), Razorpay Capital (MSME Lending), Payment Links, Payment Pages, Subscriptions, Smart Collect, Route, Payroll, and Razorpay POS. About Razorpay POS Razorpay POS is Razorpay’s comprehensive suite of point-of-sale payment solutions, enabling businesses to accept seamless payments across all customer touchpoints—over the counter, on delivery, or via kiosks and vending machines. Powering over 600,000+ touchpoints across India & the UAE, Razorpay POS (formerly Ezetap, acquired in August 2022) delivers high transaction success rates, real-time transaction analytics via the merchant portal, and flexible in-store EMI options for consumers. Role Overview We are looking for an energetic Banking Solutions Consultant (Manager - Banking Solutions) with domain expertise in digital payments, bank gateway integrations, merchant acquiring, and pre-sales technical consulting. In this role, you will act as a solution evangelist—stitching together Razorpay’s product capabilities to solve stated and unstated business requirements for banks, alliance partners, and enterprise merchants. You will combine deep technical understanding with product and program management to lead solution discovery, design custom payment architectures, and drive integrations to deployment. Key Responsibilities Pre-Sales Consulting & Solution Discovery Present and demonstrate Razorpay’s unique value proposition during executive presentations and discovery sessions with prospective and existing bank partners and enterprise merchants. Map Razorpay’s product suite (Payment Gateway, POS, RazorpayX, Capital) and roadmap against customer requirements to design end-to-end payment architectures. Prepare functional scope documents (FSD), product requirement documents (PRD), and technical scope of work specifications for merchant acquiring solutions. Partner & Bank Co-Creation Partner with banks, card networks, and processors to co-create next-generation payment and banking solutions that address evolving merchant needs. Serve as the strategic bridge between Razorpay and external banking product and sales teams to drive ecosystem alignment. Platform & Program Delivery Manage and deliver merchant acquiring payment platforms across delivery channels including payment gateways, transaction processing, settlements, and dispute management. Collaborate internally with Razorpay's business, product, engineering, and customer success teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. Facilitate support during UAT, certification testing, SDLC tracking, and platform troubleshooting across both issuing and acquiring frameworks. Relationship & Stakeholder Management Maintain proactive communication with bank leadership regarding product delivery roadmaps, platform upgrades, and feature rollouts. Drive conversations across cross-functional groups, resolve alignment conflicts, and maintain momentum across long-term project lifecycles. Qualifications & Skills Experience Minimum 5+ years of experience in pre-sales, technical consulting, product management, or platform delivery within digital payments, merchant acquiring, IT, or a leading financial institution. Prior experience at a fintech company with exposure to banks, or within a bank's product/payments team, is strongly preferred. Education MBA graduate with a solid background in software technology and architecture. Domain & Technical Knowledge In-depth understanding of payment products, merchant acquiring, payment gateways, transaction processing, card networks, settlement mechanics, and dispute workflows. Hands-on familiarity with end-to-end (ETED) transaction flows, SDLC processes, and system troubleshooting. Expertise in issuing and acquiring solutions offered to business partners. Exposure to payment network integrations (Visa, Mastercard, Rupay) and security certifications is a strong plus. Core Competencies Solution Evangelism: Ability to synthesize complex technical features into intuitive business solutions. Documentation & Presentation: Exceptional documentation skills (PRDs, FSDs) and executive presentation capabilities. Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated ability to manage and influence internal product teams, external bank executives, and merchant partners. Communication & Drive: Outstanding written and verbal communication, high energy, adaptability, and conflict resolution capabilities across distributed teams Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

title: Maps Specialist (India) - DoorDash Dot
description: About the Team DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last mile logistics in the long term. If you have a passion for applying robotics solutions in a service used by millions of people, we want to talk to you! About the Role In this role, your main focus will be to work on curating new zones of our HD maps which are utilized by our autonomous delivery robot. A primary focus of the role will be to use in-house tooling to curate and annotate specific features of the real world into our maps (lane geometry, junction locations, traffic lights, etc.). These maps are essential to our autonomous driving capabilities and allow us to expand our coverage of neighborhoods and cities where our robots will operate, performing deliveries to real customers. You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… Take charge to execute the required tasks for the map zones are you assigned Ensure a high level of quality such that additional reviews and fixes are kept to a minimum Suggest improvements to the tooling and possible areas for improvement/automation to increase efficiency Collaborate with other map curators to review their work and deliver high quality maps in a timely manner We're excited about you because... Familiarity with autonomous vehicle systems A self-starter. Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments with a proactive, action-oriented approach Adaptable; you exhibit the agility to swiftly grasp new concepts, adapt to evolving project requirements, and become a proficient specialist An innovator, actively seeking opportunities to enhance processes and drive improvements in quality and efficiency Exceptional attention to detail, enabling you to discern subtle visual differences in frame-by-frame comparisons Qualifications: Bachelor's degree or 2+ Years of industry experience Proficiency in using Issue Tracking Software such as Jira Exceptional analytical skills Proven ability to collaborate and communicate effectively across different functional teams Track record of high quality deliverables with minimal supervision Must be located in Hyderabad, India Nice to have... Familiarity with Linux and command line interfaces Familiarity with version control tools such as Git and ability to run basic commands/workflows Experience with image / vector editing tools like Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, or similar tools Experience with GIS tools like QGIS, ArcGIS, etc Experience with AutoCAD, Solidworks, Blender, or other 3D modeling software Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024. The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks. About the Role In this role, your main focus will be to work on a variety of QA and triage tasks to assist in the development of our autonomous delivery robot. A primary focus of the role will be to triage the logs of the daily testing runs of the robots conducted in the US. This includes replaying and analyzing specific events as annotated by the testing team, categorizing such events, and working with the software team to evaluate any required improvements. The role could also involve setting up various simulation scenarios for testing within our simulation environment as well as creating maps used by the autonomy stack for navigation. You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… Analyze: Utilize proprietary diagnostic tools and techniques to triage and diagnose robot autonomy issues accurately and efficiently Execute: Take charge of ensuring the prompt analysis of issues, generating reports and data visualizations that effectively prioritize and summarize identified issues Build: Develop and construct diverse scenarios within a simulation environment to test and validate new autonomy features. Additionally, create and maintain a library of scenarios to support comprehensive regression testing Collaborate: Work cross-functionally with Operations, Program Management, and Software Engineering teams to provide an effective feedback loop of identifying, routing, and monitoring key issues across various systems of the autonomy stack Optimize: Streamline and enhance QA processes and workflows Lead: Have opportunities to take end-to-end ownership of QA initiatives, encompassing process establishment, defining metrics, new team member training, execution, quality auditing, and reporting We're excited about you because... Familiarity with autonomous vehicle systems A self-starter. Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments with a proactive, action-oriented approach Adaptable; you exhibit the agility to swiftly grasp new concepts, adapt to evolving project requirements, and become a proficient specialist An innovator, actively seeking opportunities to enhance processes and drive improvements in quality and efficiency Exceptional attention to detail, enabling you to discern subtle visual differences in frame-by-frame comparisons Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field, or equivalent work experience to 2+ Years of industry experience as a QA Engineer or equivalent Proficiency in using Issue Tracking Software such as Jira Exceptional analytical skills Proven ability to collaborate and communicate effectively across different functional teams Track record of high quality deliverables with minimal supervision Must be located in Hyderabad, India Nice to have... Familiarity with Linux and command line interfaces Familiarity with version control tools such as Git and ability to run basic commands/workflows Experience with one or more data analytics and business intelligence tools, such as Sigma Experience with SQL Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024. The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. This role is part of a founding engineering team in India, offering high ownership, strong growth opportunities, and direct influence over the platform’s long-term architecture. You will work on systems such as: Platform foundations for reliability, observability, cost-efficiency and compliance A unified data discovery and catalog experience AI-powered assistants and workflows for analytics and operations You will collaborate closely with product managers, data engineers, and analytics teams to deliver solutions that reduce friction and increase trust across the data ecosystem. title: Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation
description: About the Team At DoorDash, people are our most important asset. The People Technology Team helps to deliver and facilitate strategic technology projects within the People Team. This role will be focused on supporting our People Technology function as we continue to optimize the advancement of our organization. We’re looking for Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation to help us scale Wolt + DoorDash’s enormous growth. Come help shape a best in class People Technology team! About the Role Based in India, we are looking for a Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation with demonstrated HRIS ownership to assist with strategic initiatives across our organization. Experience with Workday is preferable for this role. You will work cross-functionally to achieve business goals through system configuration, testing and documentation. As a Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation you will help deliver solutions to support business strategy, and assist in the implementation, maintenance and enhancement of people technology systems. You're excited about this opportunity because... Configure and maintain Workday Compensation module elements, including compensation packages, grades, grade profiles, matrices, eligibility rules, and compensation review/merit cycles Partner with Total Rewards to translate compensation strategy (base pay, bonus, equity, allowances) into scalable Workday configuration Lead annual and off-cycle compensation events (merit, bonus, and stock cycles) end-to-end, including planning, testing, mass data loads via Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), and validation Build and maintain compensation grades, guidelines, and eligibility rules to support pay equity and market-competitive pay decisions Partner with Payroll and Finance to ensure accurate downstream processing of compensation changes Provide global production analysis and support (break/fix analysis, reporting, business process administration, etc.) for Compensation Troubleshoot and resolve compensation-related issues, working cross-functionally with HRBPs and Payroll Manage Workday releases (bi-annual updates) by reviewing new compensation features, assessing impact, and coordinating regression testing Rigorously document compensation configuration and business processes to build operational excellence Ensure data integrity across compensation data, working closely with cross-functional teams to identify improvement opportunities Train end-users and peers on compensation processes and self-service functionality as needed Maintain the security groups and access policies tied to compensation data as a light, supporting part of the role We're excited about you because... You have 5+ years of work experience in Workday Compensation maintenance/configuration Proven experience leading full compensation review cycles (merit, bonus, stock) within Workday You are passionate about system optimization and employee experience You are a strong business thinker, able to use ‘first principles’ to solve challenging business problems at their root level You are data-driven, able to analyze data with strong attention to detail and accuracy, and passionate about telling the story behind the data hence turning the data into configuration You are a self-motivated, rapid learner, excited about further developing your analytical and problem-solving skills Basic working knowledge of Workday security concepts (security groups, domain policies) as they relate to compensation data access You are results-oriented, always evaluating whether our team’s activities are achieving the desired, measurable impact You are an owner, always looking for opportunities to learn and better your work product You are comfortable and thrive in a fast-paced, continually changing team-oriented environment and able to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously You have a BA/BS degree in quantitative or business fields, or equivalent work experience You have an analytical mindset and a “People First” mentality with demonstrated ability to work through complex, ambiguous problems using data and creating configuration solutions based on that data You have strong written/verbal communication Workday certified in Compensation preferred Next steps If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going! We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today! Please note that we do not accept applications coming in via email. Please submit your application in English via our job portal. This role involves crafting and managing integrations within Workday, enhancing system functionality, and providing essential support to our business operations. Design and implement robust integration solutions connecting Workday with internal and external systems using tools such as Workday Studio, EIB, and Core Connectors, Picof/ PECI Ensure the accuracy, efficiency, and security of data through comprehensive testing and error management. Provide ongoing support and maintenance for existing integrations, serving as the primary technical contact for business teams. Document all integration processes and maintain a detailed log of system changes and updates. System Configuration and Enhancement: Develop custom Workday Extend applications by working closely with business stakeholders to meet their needs. Recommend and implement improvements and innovations within the Workday platform. Lead the integration aspects of Workday system upgrades, ensuring compatibility and functionality with new releases. Compliance and Collaboration: Work alongside the HR team to ensure system security, business process compliance, and alignment with audit requirements such as SOC and SOX. Engage with the broader Workday community to stay abreast of new technologies and best practices, using this knowledge to propose solutions that address business challenges. Project and Implementation Leadership: Lead Workday integration projects from conception through to successful execution, ensuring alignment with the overall People Tech roadmap. Manage the implementation of system configurations, testing, training, and deployment to enhance user adoption and satisfaction. Our Humble Expectations 3-4 years of experience in Workday integration development and support, including at least 1 year of experience with Workday Extend. Demonstrable knowledge of Workday technologies such as Workday Studio, EIBs, Core Connectors, BIRT Reporting, PECI, Cloud Connectors, and Document Transformation. Proficiency in data transformation languages including XSLT and XTT/ETV. Strong capability in designing complex reports and dashboards. Excellent analytical skills and the ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with discretion. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven track record of effective project management and cross-functional collaboration. A Workday integration certification is highly desirable. About you: You are a creative problem-solver who is enthusiastic about leveraging technology to streamline and enhance business processes. You possess a solid understanding of core HR business practices and are adept at applying this knowledge in a technical environment. Your approach is proactive, and you are recognized for your organizational skills and your ability to lead projects effectively. Join our team and contribute to our mission of maximizing the potential of our HR technologies to drive business success. title: Career Manager
description: Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together. Career Manager - Chennai Chennai, India | Work Model: On-site Guide our Chennai Consultants through transformative career journeys while building operational excellence that directly fuels Customer Success and business growth. ABOUT THE TEAM The People Team partners with Appian's Professional Services organization to develop world-class consulting talent delivering AI-Powered Process Automation solutions to our clients. This team owns the full consultant lifecycle—from onboarding through career progression—ensuring our consultants have the coaching, development, and support needed to drive client transformation. Your work directly impacts retention, performance, and the capability of teams solving complex mission-critical challenges. THE OPPORTUNITY As Appian scales its footprint, the demand for exceptional consulting talent has never been higher. This role exists to ensure our consultants don't just deliver projects—they build careers, develop deep expertise, and become trusted advisors to clients. You'll shape how we grow, retain, and elevate talent in a high-stakes environment where performance and people development are inseparable from business success. WHAT YOU'LL DO Oversee and continuously improve systems and processes that support talent development, evaluation, feedback, and retention. Partner with top consultants to develop consulting career development frameworks. Contribute and enhance performance management processes, including feedback cycles, performance reviews, and promotion calibrations, in collaboration with Project Engagement Managers and Technical Advisors. Work closely with Customer Success global leaders to align talent development and retention initiatives with regional business objectives. Ensure career aspirations and business needs are aligned in support of consultants’ professional growth, skill development, and career progression. Serve as a trusted resource to consultants, fostering ongoing conversations around career growth and performance. Guide consultants through their learning and development journey, advising on training, skill-building, and engagement opportunities to advance their careers. Connect consultants with the most appropriate advisors to support their career ambitions. Drive strong engagement through frequent consultant interaction and alignment with key internal stakeholders. Support internal operational processes (e.g., feedback tracking, timesheets, compliance) to ensure efficiency without disrupting client-facing responsibilities. You’re a people person, capable of providing proactive 1-on-1 counsel to 50 consultants, promoting a positive and productive work environment. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS You have a bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Organization Development, or a related field. 5-7 years of experience in Human Resources, Talent Management, or Career Counseling within a consulting or professional services environment. Proven experience managing a pool of resources in a consulting or professional services organization with strong one-on-one coaching and mentoring capabilities. Ability to strategically align workforce capability development with short and long-term business objectives. Proven ability to develop talent in a way that directly supports business performance and growth. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Detail-oriented, highly organized, and excel at setting up meetings, tracking goals, and managing processes. Adept at navigating challenging situations and driving difficult conversations toward resolution with tact and professionalism. Facilitative working style; you excel working in a place characterized by ambiguity and unknowns. You lead with questions, not only answers. Passion for continuous improvement. Possess humility and continual drive for learning. Collaborative and support others; you do not view the world as a zero-sum game. #TalentManagement #CareerDevelopment #PeopleOperations #PerformanceManagement #ProfessionalServices Tools and Resources Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires. Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities. Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups . These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company. Benefits Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to. About Appian Appian provides AI automation for the most important business processes at the world’s largest organizations. Our platform is known for its unique power, reliability, and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and have proven expertise in enterprise operations. For more information, visit appian.com . Follow Appian: LinkedIn , YouTube , Instagram , Facebook , and X . Appian is an equal opportunity employer that strives to attract and retain the best talent. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Appian provides reasonable accommodations to applicants in accordance with all applicable laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at ReasonableAccommodations@appian.com . Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address. Appian's Applicant & Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Demo Engineer / Presales Solutions Consulting
description: Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together. Demo Engineer Here at Appian, our core values of Excellence and Intensity define who we are. In short, this means we constantly seek to understand the best for our customers, we go beyond completion in our work, we strive for excellence with intensity, and we embrace candid communication. These values guide our actions and shape our culture every day. When you join Appian, you'll be part of a passionate team that's dedicated to accomplishing hard things. SC 2.0 is the engine powering our vision . Appian's Sales Solutions Consulting team is in the midst of an exciting transformation -- redefining what it means to be a trusted advisor in today's fast-paced, mission-driven environment. Our SCs don't just demo features -- they tell stories, co-create with customers, and help shape strategy with technical credibility and business insight. Read More About SC 2.0 Here You can listen to our Global SSC leader, Gregg Aldana discuss SC 2.0 here . The SPEAR Team (Strategic Presales Execution and Readiness) is the operational engine behind Appian's global Presales organization -- the team that builds the tools, assets, governance, and infrastructure that let Solutions Consultants do their best work. As a Demo Engineer on SPEAR, you are not on the sidelines of SC 2.0 -- you are one of the people making it possible at scale. The Role Behind every great demo is a great demo asset, and that's where you come in. As a Demo Engineer on Appian's SPEAR Team in Chennai, you are the technical backbone that turns one-off sales demos into a polished, reusable, continuously evolving library that powers hundreds of sales engagements each year. While our Solutions Consultants are out in the field telling stories and co-creating with customers, you ensure they always have the right asset, in the right shape, ready to go. In this role, you'll capture, refine, and expand Appian product demos -- de-branding prospect-specific work, modernizing older assets with the latest platform capabilities, and packaging everything into reusable demos, clickable demo experiences, walkthrough videos, and scripts. You'll also contribute directly to DemoHub, Appian's centralized demo catalog and governance system -- helping evolve the application itself, not just the content inside it. You will be coached and guided by the Lead Demo Engineer based in Chennai, reporting to the SPEAR Team leadership in the US -- giving you both strong local support and direct visibility into Appian's global Presales strategy. This is a unique opportunity to develop deep expertise in the Appian platform while making a tangible, measurable impact on global sales. If you're detail-oriented, technically curious, and excited about shaping how Appian shows up to the market, this role is for you. What you'll be doing... Demo Ingestion and Cataloging: Capture product demos developed during live sales engagements and ingest them into DemoHub, ensuring they are organized, tagged, discoverable, and reusable across the global Solutions Consulting organization. De-branding and Refinement: De-brand prospect-specific demos, clean up their design and functionality, and prepare them for broader organizational use -- turning one-off assets into reusable gold. Demo Enhancement: Refresh and extend existing demos by incorporating advanced new Appian features and functionality, keeping the library current with the latest product releases, GTM narratives, and industry trends. DemoHub Application Development: Contribute to the ongoing development and maintenance of the DemoHub Appian application itself -- the platform that stores, governs, and surfaces demo content to the global SC team. This includes building new features, fixing bugs, and improving usability. Clickable Demo Production: Record, edit, and continually update interactive clickable demos in a commercial third-party demo platform, ensuring our self-service and accelerated demo experiences stay accurate, on-brand, and aligned with current product capabilities. Demo Artifact Creation: Produce supporting artifacts including walkthrough videos, demo scripts, talk tracks, and quick-reference guides that help SCs adopt and adapt assets quickly. Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Solutions Consultants worldwide, the SPEAR Team, and other Presales stakeholders to ensure demo assets reflect the latest go-to-market priorities and customer outcomes. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline demo ingestion, cataloging, and maintenance workflows, and help bring those ideas to life. Additional SPEAR Initiatives: Contribute to other Presales enablement and readiness initiatives as the SPEAR Team's portfolio evolves. Who you are... Strong experience with Appian or a similar low-code application development platform, including design, development, and debugging of applications. Excellent technical and programming skills are a must, with concrete examples of times you have applied them to deliver polished work. Attention to detail and a focus on delivering high-quality output -- the kind that other people see and immediately want to copy. Excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks in a high-volume, dynamic environment (think hundreds of demos per year flowing through your pipeline). Comfortable working on a cross-functional team and collaborating with global stakeholders across multiple time zones. Solid verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills are a must. Familiarity with interactive demo platforms (Storylane, Reprise, Navattic, Walnut, or similar) is a strong plus. Familiarity with video recording and editing tools for producing walkthrough content is a plus. Self-motivated, highly driven individual with a strong sense of urgency. B.S. or M.S. in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Math, Physics, or equivalent work experience. Tools and Resources Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires. Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities. Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups . These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company. Benefits Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to. title: Documentation Specialist
description: About Vista Equity Partners Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem. Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams. About Amtech Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise. With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem. Our Employee Value Proposition At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can: Purpose Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations. Growth Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths. Culture Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision. Innovation Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business. Role Description We are looking for a Senior Documentation Specialist to own the customer-facing documentation experience for Amtech's ERP and MES products. You will be the person who turns complex manufacturing workflows — estimating a corrugated order, scheduling a corrugator run, tracking WIP through conversion, closing the loop to invoicing — into documentation our customers actually use and trust. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will write and maintain user guides, in-application help, release notes, and how-to content; you will also set the standards, style, and structure that all Amtech product documentation follows. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Implementation, and Support, and you will be expected to learn our customers' world — the plant floor, the order lifecycle, the way a packaging manufacturer actually operates. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Documentation ownership Plan, write, edit, and maintain the full library of customer-facing documentation for Amtech's ERP and MES products, including user guides, configuration and administration guides, quick-reference materials, and in-application help. Own the release notes process end to end — partner with Product and Engineering each release cycle to capture what changed, why it matters, and what customers need to do about it. Audit existing content on a regular cadence; retire what is stale, rewrite what is unclear, and close gaps that show up in support tickets and customer feedback. Standards and structure Establish and enforce a documentation style guide, terminology standards, and content templates so that everything Amtech publishes reads as one voice. Define and improve the information architecture of the help center — how content is organized, searched, versioned, and navigated across product lines and releases. Administer and improve the documentation toolchain and publishing workflow; recommend improvements to tooling, single-sourcing, and reuse. Collaboration and subject-matter expertise Partner with Product Managers, developers, QA, implementation consultants, and support engineers to gather source material, validate technical accuracy, and get ahead of upcoming releases. Use the product yourself. Build a working understanding of packaging manufacturing operations and of how Amtech customers configure and run the system in production. Participate in release readiness and go-to-market planning to ensure documentation ships alongside the software, not after it. Partner with Product and Engineering to document AI-enabled capabilities as they ship, making new intelligence features understandable and trustworthy to customers. Quality and measurement Define quality standards for documentation and review the work of other contributors — writers, product managers, and engineers who contribute content. Track documentation effectiveness using search analytics, page performance, support ticket deflection, and direct customer feedback; use that data to prioritize the roadmap. SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS Required Qualification 6+ years of professional experience in technical writing, product documentation, or technical communications, with a substantial portion producing customer-facing content for a software product. Demonstrated experience documenting enterprise software — ERP, MES, supply chain, or comparable operational systems. A portfolio of published documentation you can walk us through, showing how you explain complex, multi-step workflows to a non-technical operational audience. The ability to take an engineer's explanation of a feature and turn it into instructions a plant scheduler can follow on the first read — precise, plain, and logically sequenced, with no step assumed. A rigorous eye for editing: you cut what is unnecessary, catch inconsistent terminology, and hold a large content library to one standard. Proven experience owning documentation standards — style guides, templates, terminology, and information architecture — not just executing against someone else's. Hands-on experience with a component content management or help-authoring platform — MadCap Flare, Paligo, Heretto, Document360, Zendesk Guide, Confluence, or comparable — including publishing, versioning, and single-sourcing across product lines. Proficiency with screen capture and image editing tools for clear, consistent visual documentation. Comfort working directly with software: navigating a complex application, reading a spec, testing a workflow, and validating your own instructions against the product. Ability to manage multiple concurrent releases and competing priorities with minimal supervision. Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Engineering, Information Science, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience documenting ERP and/or MES platforms, especially in a manufacturing environment. Familiarity with packaging, corrugated, folding carton, label, or other discrete or process manufacturing operations. Working knowledge of manufacturing and business concepts such as specifications, routings, scheduling, WIP tracking, inventory, order-to-cash, and shop-floor data collection. title: Collections Associate
description: About Blenheim Chalcot Blenheim Chalcot is one of the leading venture builders in the world. We have been building exciting and disruptive businesses for over 26 years across sectors including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more. These companies are all GenAI enabled and are some of the most innovative companies in the UK and increasingly around the world. The BC team in India has been instrumental to the growth and success of Blenheim Chalcot. Established in 2014, Blenheim Chalcot India serves as a pivotal launchpad for those aiming to make a difference in the realm of innovation and entrepreneurship. Blenheim Chalcot India is driven by a mission to empower visionaries to lead, innovate, and build disruptive solutions. We support our diverse portfolio of ventures and create impactful solutions that shape global trends. We provide a range of services to help new business get off the ground, including technology, growth (marketing and sales), talent, HR, finance, legal and tax, plus so much more! One of our FinTech ventures, Salary Finance is scaling fast and we’re looking to hire high energy, motivated and curious talent to support them on that journey! About Salary Finance Salary Finance is a leading global FinTech platform. We support a community of 4M employees across 575 clients (including 20% of the FTSE 100) in the UK and US, providing a suite of financial employee benefits that help employees improve their financial health and happiness. Our platform provides salary-linked savings, loans, pay advances, and financial education. We have a team of 200 brilliant and passionate colleagues across 3 countries, backed by great investors (Blenheim Chalcot, Legal & General, Experian, Goldman Sachs, Royal London, Virgin Money) with £100M in equity and £500M in debt funding raised to date. We were co-founded by entrepreneurs Asesh Sarkar (CEO), Daniel Shakhani, and former Head of Google UK and Ireland Dan Cobley (Chairman), and are authorised by the FCA. The Role We are looking for a Collections Associate to join our Customer Operations team. The ideal candidate will have previous experience in frontline collections and be confident handling customers across multiple channels, while balancing effective collections strategies with a customer-focused approach. You will be responsible for managing collections-related enquiries via Email and Live Chat, supporting the back-office processes that underpin the collections function, and ensuring all interactions and records are handled accurately, empathetically, and in line with regulatory and internal requirements. Key Responsibilities: Manage frontline Collections operations, including customer accounts in arrears and repayment-related enquiries. Handle customer enquiries across Email and Live Chat, providing clear, accurate, and empathetic support. Apply appropriate collections strategies and processes within a FinTech or financial services environment. Support customers experiencing financial difficulty or vulnerability, following appropriate vulnerability and affordability processes. Identify and respond appropriately to financial hardship, vulnerability, and potential customer risk indicators. Issue legal notices and collections-related documentation in line with regulatory and internal requirements. Manage shared inboxes, ensuring customer emails are actioned professionally and within SLA. Maintain accurate and comprehensive customer account records, case notes, and communications within internal systems. Use CRM and case management tools to manage customer interactions, account updates, and follow-ups. Support the preparation and maintenance of collections reports, trackers, and documentation. Assist with monitoring inactive and underperforming accounts. Work collaboratively with internal teams to resolve complex collections cases and customer queries. Ensure all customer interactions comply with regulatory requirements, company policies, data protection standards, and collections procedures. Identify opportunities to improve customer journeys and contribute to process and knowledge improvements. Demonstrate ownership of cases, ensuring appropriate follow-up and timely resolution. Consistently meet quality, productivity, customer experience, and operational targets. What we're looking for: Previous experience in frontline Collections operations, preferably within FinTech, banking, lending, or financial services. Strong understanding of collections strategies, arrears management, and customer repayment journeys. Experience handling customers through Email and Live Chat. Good understanding of supporting vulnerable customers and customers experiencing financial hardship. Previous experience using CRM/case management systems. Comfortable managing back-office collections processes, documentation, and reporting alongside customer contact. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate customer records. Ability to handle sensitive or challenging customer conversations with empathy, professionalism, and confidence. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. A collaborative team player who is willing to support colleagues and take ownership of shared objectives. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment and adapting to changing processes. Basic to intermediate Excel skills. What success looks like: Success in this role means consistently delivering effective collections outcomes while maintaining a high standard of customer care, quality, compliance, and operational performance. What we can offer you Be part of the World’s Leading Digital Venture Builder Have the opportunity to be a part of and learn from the incredible diverse talent in BC Be exposed to the right mix of challenges, within a culture that promotes continuous learning and development and opportunity to work with Gen AI A fun and open, if a little cricket obsessed, atmosphere – we own the Rajasthan Royals IPL team! 24 days of annual leave &10 public holiday days Private Medical for you and your immediate family & Life Insurance for yourself Important At Blenheim Chalcot, we strive to create an environment where differences are not only accepted but greatly valued; where everyone can make the most of their capabilities and potential. We promote meritocracy, competence and the sharing of ideas and opinions. We are driven by data and believe the diversity, agility, generosity, and curiosity of our people is what sets us apart as an organisation. Our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion is evident through our constant focus on recruiting, developing and advancing individuals based on their skills and talent.

title: Manager, Banking Alliances
description: Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution. Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia. Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia. But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future. What You'll Do Hunt & Close (primary focus) • Identify, prospect, and open conversations with banks, NBFCs, and fintechs to sell Razorpay's loyalty,co-brand card, gift card, and ads/media network (RMN) propositions. • Build and pitch commercial proposals, BRDs, and CVP decks tailored to a bank's card portfolio, customer segments, and P&L goals. • Drive the full sales cycle — prospecting, pitching, commercial negotiation, contracting, and closure — for new bank partnerships and program launches. • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing bank relationships (e.g., adding new benefit categories, Audience Intelligence, Ads/Media Network, or new card variants). • Own target sourcing lists and outreach cadence across banks, fintechs, and loyalty players deal & Relationship Management • Serve as the senior Razorpay point of contact for assigned bank partners through the deal lifecycle, from first pitch to commercial go-live. • Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, and contractual scope in coordination with Legal, Finance, and Product. • Coordinate internally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Finance to convert a signed deal into a live, revenue-generating program Farming (light-touch, ~10%) • Provide senior oversight on select escalations or renewal conversations where a commercial decision is required; Controllership & Audit Management Audit lead: Take ownership of the statutory audit for the division. Ensure 100% accuracy in accruals and provisions, minimizing the timeline between month-end and final reporting. Working Capital & Cash Flow Liquidity Management: Monitor the AP/AR split to ensure the division remains cash-flow positive, proactively flagging liquidity risks to the central treasury Automation & Process Design Reporting Architecture: Move away from manual Excel dependencies. Maintain and build live dashboards (Looker/Excel) to give leadership a real-time view of "Forecast vs. Actuals." Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks in billing or reconciliation (e.g., Engineering/Product gaps) and lead cross-functional projects to fix them permanently. Mandatory Qualifications Education: CA / ACCA / MBA (Finance) or equivalent from a reputed institute. Experience: 2–4 years of experience. Prior exposure to Fintech, SaaS, or high-transaction environments is a massive plus. Advanced Excel: VLOOKUPs, Index-Match, Pivot Tables and Advanced Excel fluency. You must know how to build models that don't crash under heavy data. Data Fluency: Basic knowledge of SQL or experience with BI tools (Looker/PowerBI) is highly desirable. Compliance: Strong grasp of Revenue Recognition standards (IndAS 115). First-Principles Thinker: You don't just follow the process; you ask, "Why does this process exist?" and fix it if it's broken. You are able to formulate new methodologies and come up with better fixes to problems on the go. Effective Communicator: You can explain complex accounting constraints to a sales head without using jargon. Mentor Mindset: Ability to guide and upskill interns/junior analysts, fostering a culture of ownership within the team. title: Customer Success Manager
description: About Prodigal Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations. We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time. These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved? Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them. Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America. Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next. We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect. We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje About the Role We're looking for a Customer Success Manager who thrives on chaos as much as clarity. Once an account is handed to you by our AI Deployment team after the hyper-care phase, you own it, whether that means smoothing over rough edges from a still-settling rollout or building on a genuinely stable one. Either way, your job is to go deep on that customer's business, become their most trusted point of contact, from day-to-day users to C-suite champions, and turn early usage into a lasting, expanding relationship across Prodigal's full product suite. You'll do this the way a 2026 CSM should: using AI tools yourself to move fast. That might mean walking a VP of Ops through exactly how much handle time proAgent shaved off last month before they've even asked, or having a clean, data-backed answer ready the moment a compliance lead wants to know whether proInsight flagged a specific violation, instead of promising to "get back to them" and grinding through a manual pull. What You'll Own Own the relationship: a portfolio of accounts post-handover from Deployment, from day-to-day users to CXOs. Set clear expectations, protect trust, and be the internal voice for what your customers actually need Drive value realization: make sure every account can point to measurable ROI from Prodigal's products, not just usage, and use that proof to defend renewals and justify expansion Drive growth: adoption, renewals, and expansion are the job; GRR, NRR and CSAT are the scorecard. Demo the rest of Prodigal's suite when there's a genuine cross-sell fit Go deep on the business: understand each customer's goals and day-to-day operations well enough to flag opportunities they haven't thought of yet Run QBRs, and build proof: turn strong outcomes into testimonials and case studies Partner across the company, and catch trouble early: work with Deployment, Engineering, Product, Marketing, Analytics, and Support, and flag account risk before it becomes urgent Key Competencies Customer Engagement & Retention: proactively drive usage, manage cross-sell/upsell conversations, and maintain a healthy NRR and CSAT Industry & Product Depth: genuinely understands the debt collections/consumer finance industry and the day-to-day operations of Prodigal's customers Executive Presence: comfortable running structured, high-stakes conversations with CXOs and senior stakeholders, not just day-to-day users Strategic Thinking & Project Management: brings strategic insight to client interactions and expertly manages project timelines, priorities, and customer expectations Problem-Solving: navigates ambiguity, diagnoses customer problems, and devises innovative solutions that ensure customer success Business Acumen: thinks in numbers: ROI, usage data, and account health metrics inform how you prioritize and pitch High Agency: takes ownership without waiting to be told; comfortable making calls in ambiguous, fast-moving situations What We're Looking For 3-5 years of experience in Customer Success, ideally in a B2B AI products Experience working with North America-based customers Based out of our Mumbai office, 5 days a week Familiar with 0→1 Customer Success Available during US business hours (until 4:30 PM ET) Strong customer-first mindset with excellent verbal and written communication Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment High agency individual that pursues excellence. Ready to wear multiple hats. Top Tier Benefits Health insurance for you and your family, meals at office on us, travel reimbursement, unlimited leaves, gym membership, unlimited learning & development, flexible work schedule and a world-class team to learn and grow with! From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast-paced, intellectually-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US. To learn more about us - please visit the following: Our Story - https://www.prodigaltech.com/our-story What shapes our thinking - https://link.prodigaltech.com/our-thesis Our website - https://www.prodigaltech.com/

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description: About Vista Equity Partners Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem. Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams. About Amtech Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise. With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem. Our Employee Value Proposition At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiators. We create an environment where you can: Purpose Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations. Growth Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths. Culture Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision. Innovation Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business. Role Description Amtech is executing an all-in AWS strategy: migrating our flagship Encore ERP to a multi-account, account-per-customer AWS architecture, operating LabelTraxx as a multi-tenant SaaS platform, and retiring legacy private-cloud infrastructure. Platform Engineering owns the landing zone, infrastructure as code, and the golden-path tooling that product teams build on. As a Senior Platform Engineer on the Cloud track, you will design and build core AWS infrastructure, own significant components of the Encore-on-AWS environment build system, and set the technical standard for the India cloud engineering pod. This is a senior hands-on role: you will ship infrastructure, review others' work, and mentor engineers while coordinating closely with U.S.-based architects and leadership. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Architecture & Design Design and implement scalable, secure AWS infrastructure across Amtech's multi-account organizations, including our account-per-customer Encore hosting model. Author and maintain the reusable Terraform modules and golden-path IaC patterns that other engineers build on. Design DNS, certificate, and network architecture for customer-facing environments (Route 53 delegation, ACM, VPC design). title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
description: Fospha is dedicated to building the world's most powerful measurement solution for online retail. For over a decade, we've helped teams make smarter decisions with full-funnel marketing insights, forecasting, and optimisation. With Fospha, every team moves faster and grows smarter. Trusted by leading brands across three continents, including Gymshark , Huel and Oh Polly, Fospha manages $4 billion in annual ad spend. We're scaling fast across London, Mumbai, and Austin – and we're now looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Team! The Role As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll build the products our customers rely on every day to make multi-million dollar media decisions. You'll work across the full stack - from crafting responsive, intuitive frontend experiences through to designing and scaling the backend microservices that power them - and, given the seniority of this role, you'll also help shape system design and infrastructure decisions as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and AI agents as part of our AI-first operating model, where lean, high-autonomy teams ship fast and learn faster. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who's comfortable owning a feature end-to-end - from initial design through to production - and who wants to grow their craft in a fast-moving, ambitious environment. Where you'll focus • Frontend development using modern JavaScript frameworks (React.js or Next.js) • Backend development using Python-based microservices • System design and infrastructure, contributing to architectural decisions as we scale • End-to-end feature ownership across the stack • (Nice-to-have) Exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering workflows Key Responsibilities • Design, build, and maintain full stack features - from frontend UI/UX through to backend services and APIs in Python. • Contribute to system design and infrastructure decisions, helping evolve our technical foundations as we scale. • Get involved across the full Software Development Lifecycle, from initial planning and design through execution, release, and monitoring in production. • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code, and champion good engineering practices across the team. • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate requirements into working software. • Build and consume APIs (REST/GraphQL) that connect frontend experiences to backend services. • Work with AI agents as part of our AI-first operating model, using clear specifications to shape high- quality, AI-assisted engineering work. • Take ownership of the quality, performance, and reliability of the features you ship. • Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving candid, constructive feedback. • Stay curious about new tools and technologies, including opportunities to explore Data Science / Data Engineering problems as they arise. What are we looking for? • Have around 5+ years of professional experience as a full stack / senior software engineer, with a balanced skill set across frontend, backend, and infrastructure. • Have strong, hands-on experience with front-end technologies such as React.js or Next.js, and solid backend experience building and maintaining Python-based microservices. • Are comfortable contributing to system design and infrastructure decisions, reflecting the seniority of this role. • Are comfortable working across the full stack and can move fluidly between frontend, backend, and infrastructure concerns. • Have solid experience working in an agile environment and know how to embed quality into fast-moving teams. • Bring exceptional attention to detail and a genuine ownership mindset over what you build. • Are enthusiastic about new technologies, with the ability to adapt and learn quickly - we're open to candidates with strong experience in other modern languages/frameworks if the core skill set and seniority are a strong match. • Have an awareness of spec-driven AI development and how clear specifications shape the quality of AI- assisted engineering work. • Have the confidence and initiative to evolve ideas and pull pieces of work together into meaningful change. • Have an active interest in self-learning and growing your craft. • Nice-to-have: exposure to Data Science / Data Engineering (not core to the role, but a strong plus). You don't have to tick every box. If you're a strong engineer who's hungry to step up, we'd still like to hear from you. What We Offer • Competitive salary • Be part of a leading global venture builder, Blenheim Chalcot, and learn from the incredible talent in BC. • Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities • Flexible Benefits including Private Medical Subsidiaries, Life Assurance, Pension scheme etc • 25 days of paid holiday + your birthday off! • Quarterly team socials Our Values and Principles - You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles: • Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard • Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact • Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure • Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems • Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude Above all, our people show a willingness to work together and get their hands dirty to deliver product success, which means our customers are successful!
