title: Product Manager II (Lending & Credit)
description: About Bluevine Bluevine is the largest small business banking platform in the U.S., redefining how entrepreneurs manage their money. We create modern financial solutions, from checking and lending to payments and beyond, designed to help small business owners grow, thrive, and take control of their financial future. Our best-in-class technology, advanced security, and deep understanding of the small business community give our customers the confidence to focus on what they do best. Since 2013, we’ve supported more than 750,000 small businesses nationwide. Backed by leading investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Menlo Ventures, 83North, and Citi Ventures, our 500+ person global team shares one mission: to give small businesses the financial tools they need to succeed. We’re innovators driven by big ideas, collaboration, and real impact. Here, you’ll have the freedom to take ownership, grow your career, and make a difference for small business owners across America. Ready to shape what’s next? ABOUT: Bluevine is looking for an experienced Product Manager who will own and drive the roadmap for payments, collections, capital markets, accounting & finance for the lending business unit. The platform and systems used in this domain are mission-critical and impact the experience for our clients and serves as the backbone for internal stakeholders’ workflows. This person will be responsible for articulating the business case for and delivering new features as well as enhancing our existing solutions, based on customer and stakeholder feedback and data driven analyses. This role will require collaboration with a broad set of technical and non- technical stakeholders, including R&D, risk and back-office operations, support, business operations, accounting and finance teams, and legal & compliance. WHAT YOU’LL DO: ● Own and drive the product roadmap for payments, collections, capital markets, and accounting & finance within the lending business unit — aligning features and initiatives to company strategy, OKRs, and KPIs through close collaboration with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders ● Conduct business discovery and gather requirements from a broad set of internal stakeholders, including risk, back-office operations, accounting, finance, and legal & compliance teams ● Define detailed technical specifications for new features and projects, outlining business requirements, acceptance criteria, and system design considerations — serving as a precise guide for engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle ● Partner closely with R&D and QA teams through sprint planning and execution, conducting UAT before production deployments and driving issues and bugs to resolution ● Monitor and maintain mission-critical systems across payments, accounting, and capital markets — ensuring data accuracy, integrating with banks and vendors, and enhancing internal operational tools for efficiency and scalability ● Identify the business case for new products and enhancements through data analysis, SQL-based querying, customer feedback, and stakeholder input — prioritizing work for highest business impact ● Facilitate smooth communication between R&D teams and business stakeholders, providing regular project updates, managing expectations, and proactively identifying and mitigating risks ● Conduct demo sessions for new features prior to launch and develop training materials and reports for stakeholders and partners WHAT WE LOOK FOR: ● 5+ years experience as a Product Manager in a fast-paced technology company ● Fintech lending experience is a plus but not mandatory. ● A self-starter with a bias to action who is able to move projects forward and lead a cross- functional team towards product solutions ● Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with the ability to interact with a diverse group of technical and non-technical stakeholders ● Advanced analytical skills, including experience with data analysis and SQL ● Demonstrated track record of launching successful products and features ● Experience managing complex projects with limited resources and competing priorities ● Experience with using AI tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT and Claude for research, automation and prototyping. ● B.A. or B.S. in physics, computer science, engineering, or related field ● Previous work experience in a technical role is a plus ● Masters, PhD, or MBA will be considered when evaluating work experience Benefits & Perks Excellent group health coverage and life insurance Meal allowance Transportation assistance (terms and conditions apply) growth Community-based volunteering opportunities

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Location: Mumbai, India (Andheri East) Description: We’re hiring Senior Software Engineers to lead the design and delivery of robust, scalable, and production-grade data systems across a high-growth, multi-venture environment. This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who thrives in hands-on build mode, and who can scale technical delivery without losing speed, quality, or ownership. If this is interesting, we would love to hear from you! About Blenheim Chalcot Blenheim Chalcot India is part of Blenheim Chalcot a global venture builder headquartered in London. With over 26 years of innovation, we've been at the forefront of creating some of the most groundbreaking GenAI-enabled companies. Our ventures lead the charge in digital disruption across a spectrum of industries, from FinTech to EdTech, GovTech to Media, and beyond. Our global presence spans the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia, with a portfolio that employs over 3,000 individuals, manages assets exceeding £1.8 billion, and boasts total portfolio sales of over £500 million. The role We’re hiring Senior Software Engineers to build scalable products, tools, and systems across our portfolio companies. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in hands-on engineering, writes maintainable code, and is deeply motivated by solving real-world problems with technology. You’ll work closely with product and engineering colleagues in both Mumbai and London, driving delivery within a specific business. If you're passionate about engineering craft, product-led development, and delivering systems that scale, we’d love to hear from you. Behaviours that we look for Solve problems rigorously , not reactively - breaking them down into tractable elements and considering multiple paths to resolution. Write clean, defensive code with clear structure and minimal complexity. Think about testing and observability early , automating meaningful tests and implementing relevant metrics/logging. Design systems for operations, not just development - considering CI/CD, resilience, cost, and scalability from day one. Use data to guide decisions, validating design impact, performance, and real user outcomes. Key responsibilities Working within our Engineering Centre of Excellence in Mumbai, you can expect to: Build and maintain scalable services, data pipelines, and backend systems. Write readable, efficient code and collaborate closely in code reviews. Automate robust test coverage (unit, integration, and/or contract tests). Implement data models used by analysts and ML teams; ensure schema evolution and data integrity are maintained. Participate in system design sessions and contribute to architectural discussions. Debug production issues across multiple services and layers of the stack. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-aware development practices. Opportunity This is an excellent opportunity for experienced engineers looking to step up their scope and impact. You’ll join a collaborative team with exposure to modern engineering practices, GenAI-enabled systems, and business-critical data products. You'll be part of a global network, shaping real customer outcomes. About you We are seeking to onboard candidates with a proven track record in engineering, demonstrating strong technical leadership skills and a passion for building high-quality, scalable products. Excellent teamwork, adaptability, and a strategic mindset are essential to being successful in this role. The Ideal Candidate We are looking for candidates who bring: Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java). Experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases; schema design and query optimisation. Comfort with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, Synapse). Familiarity with CI/CD practices, automated testing, and observability. Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and their real-world trade-offs. A proactive mindset: ready to take ownership, iterate fast, and learn continuously. Great communication and teamwork skills – particularly in cross-functional settings. Process We have a rigorous, but streamlined recruitment process, which respects the time of candidates and portfolio companies alike. This process starts with a 30-minute call with our Talent Acquisition team and a member of the Engineering Centre of Excellence, followed by further interviews with the Engineering Centre of Excellence team. Please note that our roles are primarily office based, with modern and well-connected office location in Andheri East. #LI-PS1

Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams using Jira or similar tools. Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills; comfortable owning ambiguous problems independently. Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex) is a plus. Role Description Amtech is strengthening its India-based IT Delivery Services capability to ensure reliable, secure, and responsive technology services. The Senior IT Engineer is a senior, hands-on technical contributor responsible for in-person Bengaluru office coverage and India time-zone execution across End User computing, infrastructure, endpoint, identity and core enterprise services. This role blends deep technical operations expertise with modernization, automation, and continuous improvement. Working closely with global IT Delivery Services peers, Cloud, and Security teams, this engineer will help ensure Amtech’s hybrid environment is resilient, scalable, and aligned with security and compliance standards (SOC 2 and ISO 27001). Partner with HR/Facilities and business stakeholders to support onboarding/offboarding logistics, office moves/changes, and local technology planning. Coordinate and manage local IT vendors (circuits, cabling, hardware repair, disposal) and track SLA performance. Administer and troubleshoot core enterprise services including identity, access, endpoint connectivity, network services, and collaboration platforms. Manage networking and remote access capabilities (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi/VPN, firewalls) to ensure reliability, performance, and secure connectivity. Maintain and enhance monitoring/alerting coverage for key infrastructure and site services to ensure uptime, performance, and rapid issue detection. Execute planned upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle activities for infrastructure components, coordinating change windows and validation. Support macOS management via JAMF (or equivalent) if applicable, ensuring consistent configuration and security posture. Ensure effective patching, encryption, and endpoint health practices in coordination with Security (EDR, vulnerability remediation workflows, compliance signals). Manage the end-to-end asset lifecycle: procurement coordination, receiving, inventory accuracy, secure handling/chain-of-custody, and certified secure disposal. Drive post-incident reviews and corrective/preventive actions (CAPAs) to reduce recurrence and improve reliability. Develop and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge articles to improve operational maturity and reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR). Automation & Modernization Develop and maintain automation to streamline endpoint provisioning, reporting, and operational workflows. Support modernization initiatives such as Zero Trust-aligned controls, identity-based access improvements, and standardization of tooling and configurations. Security & Compliance Support (Operational) Implement and support operational controls aligned with SOC 2 and ISO 27001, including asset management, access management coordination, change discipline, and evidence support. Partner with Security on endpoint compliance reporting, vulnerability remediation tracking, and control testing support for audits. Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing Work closely with IT Delivery Services leadership and engineering peers across time zones to standardize services and ensure clear handoffs. Contribute to knowledge sharing and peer coaching through documentation, automation patterns, and operational improvements (non-people-management role). Improve India endpoint operational rigor: measurable compliance reporting (patching, encryption, device health), reduced onboarding friction, and better inventory accuracy. Reduce repeat incidents by addressing the top recurring failure patterns through runbooks, automation, and preventative maintenance. Validate India site monitoring/alerting and close critical observability gaps for network and core services. SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS 5+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, endpoint engineering, or enterprise IT operations. Strong hands-on experience with Windows, Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) in a production enterprise environment. Demonstrated experience managing endpoints at scale using Microsoft Intune/Endpoint Manager (Autopilot, compliance, configuration, patching workflows). Solid networking fundamentals and troubleshooting depth (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls, DNS/DHCP concepts). Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues across endpoint, identity, network, and service layers. Experience working within structured operational processes (incident/change/problem management) and producing high-quality documentation/runbooks. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including comfort working across distributed global teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with macOS device management (JAMF) in mixed-device fleets. Experience supporting environments with AWS services and hybrid connectivity patterns. Experience with on-prem/VDC environments and hybrid integration. Familiarity with Zero Trust principles, Conditional Access patterns, device compliance signals, and modern security controls. Experience with monitoring/observability tools (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, New Relic, or equivalents). Relevant certifications (preferred, not required): Microsoft (e.g., Azure Administrator / Endpoint Administrator) CompTIA A+ / Network+ What This Role Offers A high-impact IT role supporting a globally integrated IT Delivery Services organization with meaningful modernization opportunities. Hands-on ownership of India site coverage and regional execution, with strong partnership across global IT, Cloud, and Security teams. Exposure to security and compliance-driven operations (SOC 2 / ISO 27001) in a maturing, standards-based IT environment. Opportunity to drive automation, standardization, and measurable improvements in reliability and employee experience. Why Join Amtech At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

title: AI Application Packaging Engineer
description: Title: AI Application Packaging Engineer Location: Andheri (East), Mumbai Reports to: Service Director ABOUT BLENHEIM CHALCOT: As part of the Blenheim Chalcot portfolio, we benefit from the expertise, infrastructure, and scale of the leading global venture builder. With over 25 years of experience creating and growing SaaS businesses powered by Generative AI, Blenheim Chalcot has built 60+ ventures across sectors such as financial services, education, health, and marketing. Our global ecosystem—including Scale Space in London, the Rajasthan Royals in Mumbai, and a go-to-market base in Austin—enables us to access world-class talent, tools, and support to accelerate our growth and build a market-leading business. THE ROLE: We’re looking for an AI-first ITS Engineer with strong Application Packaging expertise to join our growing team at Agilisys. In this role, you’ll work across Application Packaging, Endpoint Management, Cloud Deployment, and Automation, helping modernise IT operations through AI-driven and scalable solutions. This is an opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment where automation, innovation, and operational efficiency are at the core of what we do. ABOUT YOU: Must-Have's 5+ years of hands-on experience with SCCM and/or Microsoft Intune for application packaging, deployment, and endpoint management. Strong experience with PowerShell scripting and a good understanding of Windows Registry, File System internals, and deployment workflows. Experience managing application packaging, deployment, patching, and remediation processes in enterprise environments. Exposure to vulnerability management and patch lifecycle activities using tools such as WSUS, Active Directory, or endpoint security solutions. An AI-first mindset with interest or experience leveraging Generative AI tools to improve efficiency across packaging, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and operational tasks. Hands-on experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to streamline IT operations and deployment workflows. Desired Skills Experience with InstallShield, ORCA, VBScript, or related packaging technologies. Microsoft or vendor certifications (Intune, SCCM, Windows, Azure, ITIL). Experience supporting enterprise or regulated environments. Who You Are Behaviours & Mindset: We will hire, assess, and manage you on behaviours as much as technical skills. High Agency: You solve problems before they’re reported. Ownership: You deliver end-to-end outcomes, not just closed tickets. Outcome-Driven: You obsess over metrics like Patch Hygiene and Zero-Rework. Communicator: You can explain complex technical risks to UK-based stakeholders with ease. Clear, structured, empathetic updates across tech and business audiences. Collaboration: Support others, adapt under pressure, maintain team morale. PROCESS: Process - We have a rigorous, but streamlined recruitment process, which respects the time of candidates and portfolio companies alike. Please note that our roles are primarily office based, with modern and well-connected office location in Andheri East. Blenheim Chalcot is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values, thus making it core to our business. We strive to maximize the diversity of our workforce and welcome applications from everyone. We encourage diversity through perspective, background, identity, and thought whilst also fostering an environment where everyone can express themselves regardless of your race, religion, sex, gender, colour, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We are committed to continuing to nurture an inclusive environment and building a diverse workforce. #LI-PS1

Role Description Amtech is scaling its Platform Engineering organization in India as our products move to a fully AWS-hosted, multi-tenant SaaS model. Our SRE practice keeps Encore, LabelTraxx, and supporting platforms reliable, observable, and secure across a multi-account AWS estate. As a senior individual contributor on the SRE track, you will own the reliability of significant production domains, design the observability and automation frameworks the team standardizes on, and act as incident commander for complex, cross-service incidents. You will raise the bar for the India SRE pod: setting patterns, reviewing designs, and mentoring earlier-career engineers while remaining deeply hands-on. Key Responsibilities Reliability & Performance Design and implement monitoring, alerting, and reliability frameworks on our Open Telemetry-based stack (Open Observe, CloudWatch) integrated with PagerDuty. Define and defend SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for the domains you own, and drive engineering priorities from them. Engineer self-healing, autoscaling, and capacity management so systems recover without human intervention. Lead root cause analysis for high-severity incidents and ensure permanent, verified fixes. Automation & Operations Design reusable Terraform modules and golden-path patterns adopted across Amtech's multi-account AWS organizations. Build and harden CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including progressive delivery (blue/green, canary) and automated rollback. Operate and optimize containerized and serverless workloads (ECS Fargate, EKS, Lambda) and RDS PostgreSQL data stores at production scale. Eliminate toil systematically: identify, quantify, and automate the highest-cost operational work. Incident Response & On-Call Serve in the 24/7 on-call rotation and act as incident commander for complex, multi-service incidents. Own MTTD/MTTR improvement for your domains, with measurable targets. Author runbooks and drive game days or failure testing to validate them. Security & Compliance Engineer security into the platform: IAM boundaries, secrets management, network segmentation, and policy enforcement. Ensure services meet SOC 2 and ISO 27001 obligations with audit evidence generated automatically where possible. AI Competency Integrate AI across the delivery workflow with reusable prompts and shared context; mentor earlier-career engineers on effective, safe usage. Design validation steps for AI-assisted changes: characterization tests before AI refactors, empirical verification of AI debugging hypotheses, and rollback plans. Quantify AI productivity impact against baselines rather than impressions, and apply data classification policy to all AI usage. Technical Leadership & Collaboration Mentor SRE I/II engineers through design review, paired incident response, and code review. Partner with product development and Cloud-track peers on operability and migration readiness for Encore and LabelTraxx workloads. Champion reliability culture and consistent global standards between India and U.S. teams. Skills & Qualifications 4-6 years of hands-on SRE, DevOps, or cloud engineering experience, including ownership of production services at meaningful scale. Deep working knowledge of AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, Lambda) in multi-account environments. Strong Terraform skills, including authoring reusable modules, and fluency with GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD. Proven software engineering ability in Python (or similar) applied to automation and tooling, not just scripts. Demonstrated experience running SLO-driven operations, incident command, and blameless post-incident reviews. Experience designing observability with OpenTelemetry or equivalent (metrics, logs, traces). Solid understanding of networking, DNS, and cloud security architecture. Demonstrated integration of AI into daily engineering workflow with measured impact and designed validation, not ad-hoc usage. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated skills. Preferred Qualifications AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, CKA, or Terraform Associate. Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or account-per-customer architectures and ERP-class workloads. Experience with PagerDuty at scale (escalation policies, service ownership models). Experience operating AI/LLM workloads or building agentic automation under governance controls. Prior mentorship or tech-lead experience in a distributed global team. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

Operate and scale containerized application platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and reliability. Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines to enable consistent, automated build, test, and deployment workflows. Improve developer experience by standardizing deployment patterns, environments, and tooling. Implement and enforce security best practices across infrastructure and delivery pipelines, including secrets management and access control. Manage cloud networking and application access patterns, ensuring secure and optimized traffic flow. Contribute to observability and reliability engineering, including monitoring, logging, tracing, and incident response improvements. Collaborate with application teams to ensure smooth delivery and operational excellence across services. Promote platform standardization, automation, and governance across environments. title: Data Engineer
description: About Prodigal Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations. We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time. These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved? Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them. Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America. Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next. We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect. We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje About the role - We are looking for a passionate and driven Data Engineer to join our team. You will be instrumental in building scalable data pipelines, generating powerful insights, and supporting our AI/ML initiatives. If you enjoy working across data engineering and analytics and want to help shape the future of Agentic AI, we'd love to hear from you! 🏆 Responsibilities Design, build and manage robust data pipelines for collecting, transforming and modeling data within our Databricks data lake - dbt is your primary tool, not an afterthought Own the dbt layer end to end - models, sources, tests, macros, incremental strategies and documentation. If it touches transformation, it goes through dbt and you're accountable for it being clean, tested and re-runnable Turn raw, messy data into reliable, well-modeled assets that downstream teams can actually trust - no untested models, no undocumented logic, no shortcuts Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver actionable insights that drive product, AI and business decisions - translating business logic into dbt models that are built to last Support AI and ML initiatives by ensuring clean, validated and well-structured data is always available when the models need it Identify and fix performance bottlenecks in dbt models, Databricks queries and downstream reporting pipelines ✅ Requirements 2-3 years of hands-on experience in data engineering - you've built things in production, not just in notebooks Strong SQL - you can write and reason about complex joins, aggregations and window functions, and you know why a query is slow before you tune it Python for data engineering with production-grade PySpark or Spark SQL experience. Databricks strongly preferred Dimensional modeling - star schemas, fact vs dimension grain, SCD Type 2, and incremental loads you can confidently re-run without breaking things dbt as your transformation framework of choice - models, tests, sources and incremental strategies are second nature to you AWS hands-on experience across Lambda, S3, CloudFront, SQS and beyond AI-native workflow - we ship with Claude Code and Cursor and we expect you to use them well, not just know they exist Sharp problem solving - you find the right balance between getting it right and getting it done, and communicate clearly when tradeoffs are being made Self-driven and curious - you thrive in fast paced environments, pick things up quickly and keep an eye on what's emerging in the data ecosystem Bonus - Foundational knowledge in ML/AI fundamentals Mode of Work - In-Office (Koramangala,Bengaluru) ⚙️ Our Tech Stack Products built using Python, Cursor, Claude, dbt, Airflow Databases such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Databricks, Deployments on EKS, EC2, Lambda and other AWS services 🎁 What we offer Top Tier Benefits Health insurance for you and your family, meals at office on us, travel reimbursement, unlimited leaves, subsidized gym membership, unlimited learning & development, flexible work schedule and a world-class team to learn and grow with! From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast-paced, intellectually-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US. To learn more about us - please visit the following: Our Story - https://www.prodigaltech.com/our-story What shapes our thinking - https://link.prodigaltech.com/our-thesis Our website - https://www.prodigaltech.com/

Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise. With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technological organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem. Our Employee Value Proposition At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can: Purpose Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations. Growth Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths. Culture Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision. Innovation Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business. Role Description We are looking for a Product Owner II to lead product execution for our automated scheduling applications across our labeling and corrugated ERP platforms. This role works closely with product management, engineering, UX, and customers to ensure our scheduling products deliver measurable operational value for manufacturers. Working under the direction of a Product Manager, the Product Owner translates roadmap initiatives and projects into actionable development work. This individual will own the product backlog, break initiatives into epics and stories, coordinate multi-team planning, and collaborate with engineering to deliver high-quality scheduling capabilities. The ideal candidate understands manufacturing operations, ERP systems, and production scheduling, and is comfortable working with both technical teams and manufacturing customers. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Product Ownership Own and manage the product backlog for the automated scheduling products. Work with Product Managers to create epics from initiatives and roadmap projects. Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and bug fixes based on customer needs, product strategy, and business goals. Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria for development teams. Work with tech leads and development teams to plan sprints across multiple months. Ensure backlog items are ready for sprint planning and development. Customer & Market Insight Work with the Product Manager to understand and implement the roadmap. Work with customers, customer support, and services to fix software defects and to define and implement customer-specific features. title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: About Prodigal Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations. We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time. These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved? Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them. Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America. Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next. We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect. We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje About the DSML Team The Data Science and Machine Learning (DSML) team owns the full lifecycle of Prodigal's ML systems, from data curation to model selection, fine-tuning, and post-training, through to deployment, evaluation, and ongoing monitoring. We sit close to real product and customer problems, and we're expected to move from experiment to production with both speed and rigor. What You'll Do Understand the problem domain. Work closely with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to turn ambiguous, real-world problems into well-scoped ML problems. Curate datasets. Source, clean, and structure the data needed to train and evaluate models, often before any "off-the-shelf" dataset exists. Train models across the full spectrum. Build and train everything from simple classifiers to neural networks, transformers, and small/large language models, choosing the right level of complexity for the problem at hand. Deploy and scale for inference. Take models from notebook to production. optimizing for latency, cost, and reliability at scale. Evaluate and close the loop. Design evaluation frameworks that actually measure what matters, and build learning loops. What You Bring Strong fundamentals in ML/DL, backed by hands-on experience training and shipping models, not just coursework or competitions. High agency, you take an ambiguous problem and run with it rather than waiting for it to be fully specified. A first-principles approach to problem-solving – you reason from the ground up rather than defaulting to whatever's fashionable or familiar. Genuine curiosity and the comfort to operate at the edge of what you already know. Why This Role Real problems, real models, real data. No toy datasets, no academic benchmarks — you'll work on problems that directly affect customers and the business. Frontier technology, applied. Learn to harness the latest in AI and put it to work on problems that matter. Smart people, fast shipping. Work alongside a sharp team, ship quickly, and grow faster than you would elsewhere. What You Bring 2-5 years of hands-on engineering experience, with good exposure to building or working with ML or AI systems in production. Solid Python fundamentals - you are comfortable writing clean, maintainable code and debugging production issues. Some experience working with LLMs: prompt engineering, API integrations, or building simple pipelines or agents. High bias for action - you don't wait to be told exactly what to do, and you push yourself to ship rather than over-engineer. Eager to learn in a fast-moving environment, take ownership of your work, and ask good questions. Top Tier Benefits Health insurance for you and your family, meals at office on us, travel reimbursement, unlimited leaves, gym membership, unlimited learning & development, flexible work schedule and a world-class team to learn and grow with! From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast-paced, intellectually-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US. To learn more about us - please visit the following: Our Story - https://www.prodigaltech.com/our-story What shapes our thinking - https://link.prodigaltech.com/our-thesis Our website - https://www.prodigaltech.com/

Role Description Amtech is seeking a Principal Software Engineer / Architect to serve as the technical authority for our Label Traxx ERP platform and its ecosystem of integrations. This role owns the architecture and long-term technical direction of Label Traxx and the AWS-hosted systems that connect to it — including Cloud API, Batched, Siteline, Data Warehouse, and Supplier integrations — ensuring the platform scales reliably as Amtech’s customer base and integration footprint grow. This is a hands-on architecture role: you will define and evolve the AWS architecture, PostgreSQL data layers, and React-based frontends underpinning Label Traxx’s integration ecosystem, resolve highly complex cross-cutting technical challenges spanning multiple systems, and drive the multi-year modernization strategy that extends Label Traxx’s legacy 4D-based application through modern, AWS-native services. Deep, hands-on AWS expertise is required, since AWS underpins every integration in this ecosystem. You will partner with Amtech’s Architecture Review Board and engineering leadership to set organization-wide standards for secure engineering, scalable architecture, CI/CD, automation, and AI-assisted development — and you will coach senior engineers across the Label Traxx and integrations teams to build lasting technical capability. We value engineers who embrace modern development practices, including collaborative Git workflows, CI/CD, Agile delivery, and responsible use of AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and code quality. Key Responsibilities Serve as the recognized technical authority for the Label Traxx ERP platform and its integration ecosystem, shaping engineering standards, architecture, and long-term technical direction. Own the AWS architecture underpinning all Label Traxx integrations — Cloud API, Batched, Siteline, Data Warehouse, and Supplier integrations — ensuring each is scalable, secure, and operationally mature on a shared cloud foundation. Drive the strategic roadmap for modernizing the legacy 4D-based Label Traxx platform, extending capability through AWS-native services across all integration points, and resolving highly complex cross-cutting technical challenges through expert judgment. Define and evolve PostgreSQL data architecture and modeling standards shared across Label Traxx’s integrations, ensuring data integrity, performance, and consistency at scale. Guide architecture and technical direction for React-based frontends used by Label Traxx and its integration partners, ensuring consistency with backend and API design. Partner with the Architecture Review Board to define and evolve organization-wide standards for secure engineering, scalability, CI/CD, observability, and AI-assisted development practices. Improve engineering productivity, reliability, and delivery outcomes across the Label Traxx platform and its integration teams. Coach senior and staff-level engineers across Label Traxx and integration teams, influencing technical decisions and building organizational capability. Communicate technical direction, architecture decisions, and trade-offs to executive and cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, QA, Security, Operations). Evaluate AWS infrastructure and integration investments (compute, storage, networking, observability) needed to support Label Traxx’s growth, reliability, and cost efficiency. Guide incident response and root-cause analysis for the most complex production issues spanning Label Traxx and its integrations. Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master’s a plus). 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in technical leadership, architecture, or principal engineering roles. Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across multiple production services (e.g., ECS/Fargate, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, Secrets Manager, CloudFormation/SAM) — able to define cloud architecture standards applied consistently across several integrations, not a single service. Proven experience architecting complex, integration-heavy enterprise platforms — designing and scaling multiple system-to-system integrations (APIs, batch processes, data warehousing, or supplier/EDI-style integrations). Strong PostgreSQL expertise, including data modeling, performance tuning, and schema design for high-transaction enterprise systems. Experience with React and modern frontend architecture; able to guide frontend/backend integration decisions. Strong background in C#/.NET (ASP.NET Core) and enterprise API design; proven experience modernizing legacy or monolithic systems into service-oriented or cloud-native architectures. Proven track record defining engineering standards, secure engineering practices, and CI/CD strategy across multiple teams. Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and influence technical direction beyond a single team. Excellent communication skills; able to align technical and executive stakeholders on architecture, trade-offs, and risk. Experience guiding organization-wide adoption of AI-assisted development tools and practices is a plus. Why Join Amtech At Amtech, you will drive meaningful technical impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s Label Traxx platform and its integration ecosystem. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

About Amtech Amtech LLC is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging and manufacturing industries, helping businesses streamline operations, improve productivity, and drive sustainable growth. With a strong focus on innovation and customer success, Amtech continues to expand its global footprint and deliver technology that empowers teams around the world. Our Employee Value Proposition At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can: Purpose Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations. Growth Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths. Culture Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision. Innovation Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business. Role Description Amtech LLC is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to build and scale the Agentic Platform behind Amtech AI Intelligence — a headless, MCP-native intelligence layer across packaging and labels, and data that is callable by any AI, on any screen. This role takes Amtech's first production agent pattern and turns it into a reusable platform component that extends cleanly to EnCore, LabelTraxx, Siteline, Scorekeeper, and future use cases, rather than building a one-off solution per product. This is a senior, largely self-directed role: you'll set technical direction for the platform, make build-vs-buy calls on agent tooling, and be a technical reference point for the Forward Deployed Engineers embedding it into product pods. Curiosity about emerging agentic AI and LLM tooling, and comfort operating close to production systems and governed customer data, are essential. Job Description Headless, MCP-Native Architecture Build business logic that runs independent of any screen — the same capability must work for a person in the UI, an AI agent, or an automated job. Expose Amtech capabilities as MCP-described tools so any AI model can call them. Orchestration and Agent Execution Build and maintain the LLM orchestration layer that turns model output into safe, governed, tool-using actions. Implement and extend agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Retrieval and Model Integration Build and tune RAG pipelines for grounding agent responses in Amtech's own data. Integrate model-agnostic LLM providers — Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and whatever model leads next — via a common provider abstraction, avoiding vendor lock-in. Governed On-Prem Data Access (the Data Agent) Build and maintain the Data Agent — new technology that reads EnCore and other customer data directly for inferencing, with no dependency on legacy point-to-point APIs. title: Business Development Representative - US Market
description: About Prodigal Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations. We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time. These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved? Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them. Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America. Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next. We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect. We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje About the Role We're looking for a Business Development Representative to help open the right doors for Prodigal. Your job is simple to describe and difficult to do well: Find the right companies and people, understand why Prodigal could matter to them, start a relevant conversation, and earn the meeting. Once that meeting is qualified, you'll partner with an Account Executive who takes the opportunity forward. This isn't a role where success comes from sending the highest number of templated emails. Our customers can be lenders, card issuers, auto-finance companies, collection agencies, debt buyers, servicers, BPOs, credit unions, and healthcare organizations. Their business models, economics, regulations, workflows, and priorities can be materially different. To be great here, you'll need to learn those differences. You might spend one morning understanding why early-stage auto collections behaves differently from post-charge-off recovery, then work out why a servicing executive at a lender should care about something completely different from an operations leader at a collection agency. Then you need to reduce all of that thinking into an email someone can understand in 20 seconds, or a cold call that earns you another 30. That's the job. What You'll Do Own outbound prospecting into strategic US accounts. Identify the right companies, stakeholders, and moments to engage across phone, email, LinkedIn, events, and other channels. Learn how our prospects actually operate. Understand their business model, workflows, priorities, KPIs, regulatory environment, and where AI could realistically create value. Develop a hypothesis before you pitch. Instead of starting with what Prodigal does, work out why this particular person at this particular company may have a problem worth discussing. Create highly relevant outreach. Translate complex research into simple, sharp messages that make senior prospects want to respond. Cold call. Become comfortable speaking with senior operators and executives, navigating rejection, thinking on your feet, and earning the next conversation. Book qualified meetings and make strong handoffs. Give the AE the context behind the meeting. What matters to the prospect? Why did they engage? What did we learn? Partner closely with AEs and Marketing. Prioritize accounts, develop angles, plan event outreach, experiment with campaigns, and learn which signals actually create pipeline. Use AI aggressively, but thoughtfully. Use AI to research faster, synthesize information, generate ideas, prepare calls, and remove repetitive work. You'll still be responsible for deciding what's true, what's relevant, and what's worth sending. Keep the details right. Maintain clean account data, follow-ups, sequences, CRM records, notes, and handoffs. Turn the market into feedback. Share objections, patterns, competitive signals, buyer language, and messaging insights with the wider GTM team so our positioning keeps getting better. Represent Prodigal in person. Over time, you'll have opportunities to meet prospects at conferences and industry events. We want someone who is comfortable walking into a room, starting conversations, and building genuine rapport. What You'll Bring We care less about finding someone who already knows every sales technique and more about finding someone with the underlying characteristics to become exceptional at this job. Discipline You can do the work consistently. Prospecting has repetitive parts. Following up matters. Preparation matters. CRM hygiene matters. Good weeks don't make you complacent, and bad weeks don't destroy your routine. Commercial curiosity You genuinely want to understand how businesses work. When you encounter an unfamiliar company or business model, your instinct is to investigate rather than immediately reach for a template. You ask good questions, connect information quickly, and can form a point of view from incomplete information. Drive to get better You want progress, responsibility, and mastery, not just the next incentive payout. You review what worked, want feedback, experiment, and deliberately improve your craft. Strong judgment AI can give you ten answers in ten seconds. You can decide which one is actually good. You know the difference between something that is technically personalized and something another human being would genuinely find relevant. You verify facts, question assumptions, and care about the quality of what leaves your name. Clear communication You can take something complicated and make it simple. Strong writing matters. So does speaking naturally without hiding behind jargon or memorized scripts. Social intelligence You pay attention to the person on the other side. You can read a conversation, listen, adjust your approach, understand incentives, and recognize when to push, when to ask, and when to back off. Resilience Selling involves rejection. A prospect hanging up, ignoring your email, or telling you no doesn't ruin your day. You recover quickly, learn what you can, and move on to the next conversation. Attention to detail Names, numbers, titles, claims, dates, account history, and follow-ups matter. You don't need to be perfect, but you should care when something is wrong. Independent thinking + coachability You should have opinions. We want you to challenge messaging, suggest experiments, question assumptions, and tell us when you think something won't work. We also want you to change your mind quickly when someone has better evidence. Experience 1-3 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, SDR/BDR work, or another highly customer-facing role is preferred. Prior experience selling to US customers is useful but not mandatory. Experience in SaaS, fintech, financial services, or AI is a plus. Strong written and spoken English is important. You should be comfortable working with modern sales tools and learning new AI tools quickly. Exceptional early-career candidates with strong evidence of discipline, communication, curiosity, and drive should still apply. Why This Role Learn a difficult industry deeply You'll learn how some of the largest lenders and financial institutions in North America actually operate through live accounts and conversations. Learn how enterprise AI is actually sold Selling AI in 2026 is increasingly less about showing someone a clever demo and more about understanding their operation well enough to identify where AI can safely produce an outcome. You'll work alongside AEs, product teams, AI deployment teams, engineers, and industry experts, and see that process up close. Build judgment, not just sales activity We want AI doing more of the repetitive work over time. That should give you more time for the parts of selling that humans are uniquely good at: understanding context, forming opinions, communicating ideas, building relationships, and creating trust. Help build the playbook We're not a giant SDR organization where your job is to inherit a script and follow it. You'll have room to experiment with accounts, messaging, channels, tools, and campaigns, and the things that work can become part of how Prodigal goes to market. Real ownership early The meetings you create can turn into meaningful enterprise relationships. Your research can change how an AE approaches an account. An objection you hear repeatedly can change our messaging. A pattern you discover can influence a campaign. You will be close enough to the business to see the consequences of your work. The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here You don't need founder-level intensity. But you do need to care deeply about becoming good at what you do. You are ambitious without being impatient. Competitive without making everything about yourself. Confident enough to have an opinion and humble enough to update it. You like people. You like learning. You don't mind hearing "no." And when you encounter something you don't understand, your instinct is to figure it out. If that sounds like you, we'd like to meet you. From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast-paced, intellectually-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US. To learn more about us - please visit the following: Our Story - https://www.prodigaltech.com/our-story What shapes our thinking - https://link.prodigaltech.com/our-thesis Our website - https://www.prodigaltech.com/

description: About Prodigal Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations. We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time. These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved? Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them. Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America. Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next. We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect. We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje About the Role AI has made it incredibly easy to produce content. There are more articles, posts, emails, videos, and opinions competing for people's attention every day. We think this makes genuinely good content more valuable. We're looking for a Content Marketing Intern who wants to become exceptionally good at understanding an audience, finding ideas worth talking about, and turning those ideas into work people actually want to read, watch, save, share, and come back to. At Prodigal, good content starts with understanding. You'll learn how financial institutions operate, how their teams work, what their customers experience, what executives care about, where processes break, and how AI is changing the industry. We go unusually deep into these details. We obsess over the people, processes, regulations, and edge cases that shape how this industry actually works. That level of understanding should show up in everything we publish. We want someone inside the industry to encounter something from Prodigal and think: How do they know that? And we want the content to be good enough that they keep reading. This is an Intern + PPO opportunity (performance based). What You'll Do Research deeply Ideas can come from anywhere: earnings calls, annual reports, customer conversations, regulatory filings, job postings, datasets, online communities, sales calls, or an obscure detail several searches deep. You'll learn to enter an unfamiliar subject quickly, understand what is happening, separate signal from noise, and find the part worth telling someone about. Create content people want to finish You'll work across LinkedIn, articles, research reports, executive content, newsletters, customer stories, email campaigns, videos, event content, data-led stories, and formats we haven't tried yet. You'll think carefully about the reader throughout: - What would make them stop? - What do they already know? - What might surprise them? - Where will they lose interest? - What would make this worth sharing? The headline, structure, language, examples, and design should all come from those questions. Learn the industry You don't need to understand financial services before joining. You do need to be curious enough to learn it. You'll understand how banks and lenders make decisions, how borrowers move through different stages of a loan, why an auto lender operates differently from a card issuer, how regulations shape interactions, and what changes when thousands or millions of customer conversations need to happen at scale. Experiment Try new hooks, structures, research formats, visual treatments, videos, interactive ideas, event experiences, and approaches borrowed from great creators, journalists, consumer brands, and places outside traditional B2B marketing. Some will work. Some won't. Pay attention to why. jobDetails: About Prodigal Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations. How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved? title: Senior Implementation Consultant
description: About Vista Equity Partners Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem. Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams. About Amtech Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise. With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem. Our Employee Value Proposition At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can: Purpose Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations. Growth Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths. Culture Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision. Innovation Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business. Key Responsibilities The Implementation Consultant is expected to: Support and execute customer implementation activities, including requirements gathering, solution configuration, documentation, testing, and end-user training, in alignment with defined project scope and delivery standards. Partner with customers to analyze and interpret business requirements, contributing to solution design within Amtech’s core products while applying relevant industry best practices. Deliver ERP and industry-specific knowledge transfer to customers using Amtech’s consulting methodology to support successful adoption and long-term value realization. Contribute to the development and maintenance of standardized training materials, implementation documentation, and supporting delivery assets. Assist with customer-facing presentations and proposals, supporting implementation delivery, complex engagements, and presales activities as needed. Proactively identify delivery risks and client issues, escalate appropriately, and collaborate with internal teams to support timely resolution and achievement of project milestones. Support Amtech organizational initiatives, including sales cycle support, practice aid development, and continuous improvement of delivery processes and operating procedures. Provide peer-level mentoring and knowledge sharing within the Implementation Services team to reinforce delivery standards and improve overall implementation quality. Willingness to travel up to 50% to support customer implementations, training, and onsite project needs. REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Packaging, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of experience delivering professional services and/or supporting ERP software solutions; experience within the printing or packaging industry strongly preferred. Strong ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across concurrent projects. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to deliver clear, professional customer-facing presentations. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and follow-through. Highly self-motivated and able to work independently while managing priorities across multiple customer engagements. Comfortable presenting and communicating effectively with stakeholders at all levels of an organization, from end users to executive leadership. PREFERRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE Direct experience in the corrugated or folding carton industry Advanced familiarity with the capabilities and functionality of Amtech’s solutions. Working knowledge of accounting principles as they relate to ERP systems (e.g., invoicing, costing, financial reporting). WHY JOIN AMTECH At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

Role Description Amtech LLC is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to own the architecture, scalability, and technical direction of ACDP (Amtech Cloud Data Platform) - the data warehouses, pipelines, tenant data stores, and feature stores that power analytics, personalization, and AI agent initiatives across the company. This role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership: setting standards, mentoring engineers, and partnering with architecture and product stakeholders to shape the platform's roadmap. The Lead Data Engineer will play a central role in building the data foundation behind Amtech's AI Agents initiative — the tenant registries, tenant data warehouses, analytics/monitoring, and event pipelines that feed the Amtech Agent Hub and the broader Amtech AI Cloud. This includes helping stand up the data layer that supports agent use cases and expanding platform capabilities beyond traditional analytics into next-generation, agent-driven intelligence. This role is also central to Amtech's intentional hybrid AI strategy, which routes each use case to the right tier based on risk, data sensitivity, latency, and IP protection. The Lead Data Engineer will build and govern the data layer underneath all three tiers — the stateless Cloud AI acceleration layer, the Hybrid AI zone where cloud LLM reasoning is combined with on-prem data via a Data Agent, and the deterministic On-Prem/Private AI control layer for margin- and production-critical logic — ensuring the org, not the model, controls where sensitive data flows. Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end architecture for ACDP: data warehouses, tenant data stores, lakes, and feature stores supporting analytics, ML, and AI agent use cases. Design and build the tenant registry and tenant data warehouse layer that underpins multi-tenant AI Agent workloads. Build and govern the Data Agent layer that supplies on-prem/customer-controlled data to cloud LLM reasoning in the Hybrid AI zone, with staged, explainable data outputs and human review checkpoints. Define data classification and routing rules that determine which data can flow to Cloud AI, which requires the Hybrid AI path, and which must remain fully on-prem/deterministic — protecting customer IP and production-critical logic. Set engineering standards for ETL/ELT design, orchestration, and data quality across the team. Lead design and code reviews; mentor data engineers and act as technical escalation point. Drive automation and reliability of pipelines, including SLAs, observability, and incident response. Own data security, access control, lineage, and governance compliance at the platform level, across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem tiers. Partner with data scientists and analysts to ensure platform data is ML-ready and supports predictive modeling. Build and maintain the data/event pipelines connecting ERP source systems (e.g., EnCore) to the EnCore Agent Hub, supporting secure read/write and event-and-trigger flows. Guide GenAI/LLM data enablement, including embeddings, vector database design, and RAG pipeline architecture, in support of Amtech AI Cloud agent orchestration. Represent data engineering in cross-functional architecture (ARB) and platform roadmap discussions. Optimize pipelines for low-latency access; establish partitioning, caching, and indexing strategies as team standards. Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline. 10+ years of experience in data engineering or software development, including 3+ years in a technical lead or architect capacity. Deep expertise in data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery). Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Scala. Proven experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, AWS Glue). Hands-on ownership of cloud platforms at scale (AWS, Azure, or GCP), plus familiarity with on-prem/private deployment models. Proficiency with big data frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink) and streaming tools (Kafka, Kinesis). Expert-level SQL and NoSQL databases; familiarity with time-series or graph databases is a plus. Experience setting data validation, governance, and observability standards (e.g., Great Expectations, Prometheus, Grafana). Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers or leading a technical team. Experience designing multi-tenant data architectures (tenant registries, tenant-scoped data stores/warehouses) is a strong plus. Understanding of data sensitivity/risk classification and hybrid cloud/on-prem routing for AI workloads is a strong plus. Preferred Qualifications Advanced training in Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture, or Industrial Data Systems. Experience with ERP, MES, or manufacturing data environments. Familiarity with IoT/OT data pipelines, including machine telemetry and SCADA signals. Applied experience with GenAI tools such as LangChain, vector databases, and RAG pipelines in production. Exposure to agent orchestration platforms, MCP-style tool routing, or event-driven agent architectures. Experience building or governing hybrid AI architectures balancing cloud acceleration with on-prem/private control layers. WHY JOIN AMTECH At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista
